races.race_name: Hong Kong Jockey Club World Pool Handicap (Heritage Handicap)

runners.name: Air Force One
runners.spotlight: Finished third behind Trefor and The Man in this race 12 months ago, having to wait for a gap but finishing off fastest of all; continued the good work this term, most recently finishing third of 21 to Stratusnine here (6f, good to firm) last month; 8lb better off with that rival for under one length; big run on the cards.
runners.comment: 3rd in this race last year, finishing off fastest; good 6f run here last time; big chance

runners.name: Gold Star Hero
runners.spotlight: Three front-running AW wins in the spring saw him soar up the handicap; ran right up to his best when second of ten in a Shergar Cup race at Ascot (5f, good to firm) 11 days ago; runs off the same mark but this looks a deeper event.
runners.comment: Three AW wins in spring; comparable form when 2nd at Ascot 11 days ago; this is tougher

runners.name: Dubai Bling
runners.spotlight: Wins in Bahrain (6f, good to firm) and at Ascot (5f, good to firm) this summer; stiff task under a penalty in the Stewards' Cup 18 days ago and ran respectably in midfield; the Ascot form makes him of interest and he could prove suited by this intermediate trip; whether his high draw proves beneficial remains to be seen though.
runners.comment: Two sprint wins in big fields this year; midfield in Stewards' Cup latest; 3lb lower today

runners.name: Lexington Blitz
runners.spotlight: Better than ever this year following a gelding operation, winning at Goodwood (5f, good) in May and running with credit at Epsom (the Dash) and Glorious Goodwood since; should give his running but might find one or two better treated today.
runners.comment: In good form this year but perhaps a shade high in the weights for a race like this

runners.name: Against The Wind
runners.spotlight: Had some strong form as a 3yo, including at York, and he returned to action in March with a good third at Southwell (5f, AW); two heavy defeats have followed (had a wind op after the first) and he arrives with a point to prove.
runners.comment: Promising return in March (5f, AW) but two heavy defeats have followed; not a solid option

runners.name: Corolla Point
runners.spotlight: Successful in 5f handicaps twice last September having moved to Ed Bethell; beaten favourite on his first three starts this year, including here, but still ran to a useful level; managed to put his head in front, just, at Hamilton (5f, good) 18 days ago and although a 3lb rise didn't look overly generous, the third has won since; still has potential after just nine runs.
runners.comment: Narrow win at Hamilton (5f, good) has been franked; still has low mileage; one to consider

runners.name: Stratusnine
runners.spotlight: Looked one to follow when bolting up at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in December and, after a series of misfortunes befell him early in the year, things have finally clicked this summer; saw off his 20 rivals over 6f here last month and then went down all guns blazing in the Stewards' Cup; another 3lb higher today but may not have reached his ceiling; high draw could be a negative.
runners.comment: 6f win here followed by fine 2nd in Stewards' Cup; up 3lb but potentially a Group horse

runners.name: Toca Madera
runners.spotlight: He has performed with credit in all three York runs; two fine runs at Glorious Goodwood, notably in the Stewards' Cup in which he would have gone very close to winning granted a clear run at a crucial stage; races off the same mark and has a big run in him.
runners.comment: Would have gone very close in Stewards' Cup with a clear run; big run in him off same mark
runners.owner: L Bond & Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi

runners.name: Naana's Sparkle
runners.spotlight: On the up for new trainer this year, winning 5f handicaps at Yarmouth and Southwell before a fine second at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good) three weeks ago, hitting the front 110 yards from home but picked off late on by a thriving opponent; 3lb rise asks a stiffer question.
runners.comment: On the up for new stable, narrowly denied at Glorious Goodwood latest; 3lb rise asks more

runners.name: Ziggy's Triton
runners.spotlight: Course winner last month but has done all his winning at Class 4 level or lower; likely vulnerable in a race of this nature.
runners.comment: Course winner but all his wins have come in Class 4 or lower; opposable at this level

runners.name: Candy
runners.spotlight: Won last season's Ayr Silver Cup off a 5lb lower mark; has not had much luck this year, banging his head in the stalls in the Wokingham and then suffering a slipped saddle at Goodwood three weeks ago; for one so well suited by 6f and slow ground, today's test may be insufficient.
runners.comment: Last year's Ayr Silver Cup winner; excuses both runs this year; 6f perhaps more suitable

runners.name: Stormy Impact
runners.spotlight: 0-4 this year but retains ability; there's a slight concern that she will get taken off her feet early under these conditions and others appeal more.
runners.comment: Has not won this year but retains some ability; today's test may not play to her strengths

runners.name: Dark Thirty
runners.spotlight: Coaxed back to his best by the Quinns this year, winning 6f handicaps here and at Chester and then running a fine race in a hot sprint handicap at the Curragh last month; weakened in the closing stages of the Stewards' Cup, a race in which he was 5lb well in, and a personal best is needed to defy this highest mark of his career over the shortest trip he will have tackled.
runners.comment: Having a good year but on a tough mark now and unraced at shorter than 6f

runners.name: Apollo One
runners.spotlight: Fine servant to connections down the years; retains ability but he wasn't at his best here last month and younger rivals may have his measure.
runners.comment: Fine servant down the years; not at his best here last month; vulnerable to younger legs

runners.name: The Man
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f handicap at last season's Dante meeting here and confirmed the track suited him well when collared late by Trefor in this race 12 months ago; 3lb lower this time around and he has done enough in 2026 to think he retains all his ability; trainer is making a name for himself in the big sprint handicaps and it's likely this has been the main aim all summer; big chance if getting it right at the start.
runners.comment: 3lb lower than when second in this race last year; retains his ability; high on the list

runners.name: West Acre
runners.spotlight: Has plenty of ability (two Group-race wins in Dubai) but slow starts have crept in, notably in the Stewards' Cup 18 days ago; the experiment with blinkers has been quickly aborted but he is a risky proposition for now.
runners.comment: Two-time Group-race winner but slow starts have crept in this year, notably last time

runners.name: Dapper Valley
runners.spotlight: Coaxed back to form by James Owen last autumn; had an unsuccessful stint in the Middle East over the winter but returned to Owen and won handicaps at Leicester (6f) and Salisbury (5f) in the spring; sold for 25,000gns last month; looks on a tough mark ahead of his stable debut.
runners.comment: Flourished for James Owen; sold 25,000gns last month; tough mark for stable debut

runners.name: Erosandpsyche
runners.spotlight: Irish raider; he has run some solid races in defeat this summer but this looks a tough race in which to try to end a four-year drought.
runners.comment: Irish raider; in good form this summer but he hasn't won for four years

runners.name: Spartan Arrow
runners.spotlight: Had a fine year in 2025, winning four times including in Listed and Group 3; not in comparable form  in 2026 but he has too much ability to be discounted completely.
runners.comment: Has not hit 2025's heights this time around; down in the weights but not a solid option
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Ltd XXXI And Partner

runners.name: Trefor
runners.spotlight: Travelled powerfully before wearing down The Man close home in this race 12 months ago; he arrives 3lb higher this time around, penalised for last week's Windsor success (a race in which he was second before his win here last year); whether his draw in stall 20 is a positive remains to be seen though.
runners.comment: Won from The Man in this race last year; fine win at Windsor last week; stall 20 a query
runners.owner: Julie Martin & David R Martin & Partner

runners.name: Another Baar
runners.spotlight: Won a local Group 1 in Bahrain in January but got clobbered by the handicapper as a result; slipping back to a more realistic mark but drawn highest and others bring much more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Back to a more manageable mark now but drawn highest and looks vulnerable again

races.race_name: Tattersalls Acomb Stakes (Group 3) (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Haffner
runners.spotlight: Won at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last month on second start, before close second in the Group 2 Vintage Stakes at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good); he's in excellent hands to continue to progress and holds leading claims.
runners.comment: Runner-up in the Group 2 Vintage at Glorious Goodwood and holds leading claims

runners.name: Alfred Wallace
runners.spotlight: Led when fifth of seven in Group 2 Superlative Stakes at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last month and showed improved form under more patient tactics for Listed win at Ascot (7f, good to firm) 13 days later; his dam was a Group 1 winner and he could continue to progress; respected.
runners.comment: Held up and improved form when Listed winner at Ascot; dam won a Group 1; respected

runners.name: Gentle Hurricane
runners.spotlight: 105,000euros yearling who was backed into 4-1 when winning on debut at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) last month, when coming clear with a previous winner; he takes a leap in grade on this second start but looks a good prospect for 7f and his trainer won this in 2022 and 2025; interesting.
runners.comment: Won Salisbury maiden last month; trainer won this in 2022 and 2025; interesting

runners.name: Stardom Glory
runners.spotlight: Runner-up over 6f here on first two starts (good) before keeping on strongly to win at Chester (6f, good) in June; improvement is necessary up in grade but his trainer has some useful 2yos and this colt shaped as though the step up to 7f could be a positive; not discounted.
runners.comment: Kept on strongly to win over 6f at Chester and the step up to 7f could be a positive

runners.name: Big Cigar
runners.spotlight: Came clear with next-time-out winner when scoring on nursery debut here (6f, good to firm) last month; the return to York could be a positive but he finished seventh of ten in the Group 2 Richmond at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good to firm) and others have a lot more substance to their claims.
runners.comment: Won 6f nursery here last month but down the field in Group 2 at Goodwood subsequently

runners.name: Clash Of Hearts
runners.spotlight: Built upon the promise of his first two starts (debut here) to make all by 5l at Pontefract (6f, good) in June; respectable run in big field on nursery debut at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good to firm) last time but a chunk of improvement is necessary if he's to pose a serious threat today.
runners.comment: Respectable run in Glorious Goodwood nursery last time but chunk of improvement is needed

runners.name: Fuel The Jet
runners.spotlight: Well backed when fifth on debut at Thirsk (7f, good) in May and displayed improvement for head win at Newbury (7f, good to firm) last month; Chaldean and Gewan won that same novice before following up in this race; unexposed and represents in-form yard but others have achieved more.
runners.comment: Won at Newbury on second start; unexposed and yard in form but others have achieved more

runners.name: Trean
runners.spotlight: Eye-catching third on debut at Fairyhouse (6f, good) in June and bounced back from disappointing run at the Curragh to make all in fine style at Galway (7f, yielding) last month; he's highly regarded by his Irish trainer and could have a big part to play.
runners.comment: Easily made all at Galway on third start; highly regarded; could have a big part to play

runners.name: Siouxperb
runners.spotlight: 4l win when odds-on for his debut at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) in April and bounced back from heavy defeat at Royal Ascot to go close under a penalty in a novice at Newcastle (6f, AW) last month, when clear with an odds-on newcomer; however, it is likely that his limitations will be exposed today.
runners.comment: Back on song when going close under penalty in AW novice, but likely vulnerable today

runners.name: Vega King
runners.spotlight: Close fourth of five on debut at Ayr (7f, good to firm) last month and built on that to make all narrowly at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) three weeks ago; that latest form has been franked and he represents a powerful 2yo stable, but he needs another step forward if he's to follow up this afternoon.
runners.comment: Won at Beverley on second start and form has been franked, but needs another step forward

races.race_name: Sky Bet Great Voltigeur Stakes (Group 2) (Colts & Geldings)

runners.name: Maltese Cross
runners.spotlight: His only defeat this season came at the hands of Christmas Day when second, beaten two and three-quarter lengths, in the Derby at Epsom (1m4f, soft); snatched the Group 1 Grand Prix de Paris at Longchamp (1m4f, good to firm) from the fire after trouble in running five weeks ago; has 5lb penalty but every race has brought improvement.
runners.comment: Derby second to Christmas Day, before French Group 1 win; 5lb penalty but keeps improving

runners.name: Christmas Day
runners.spotlight: Galloped on relentlessly to win the Derby from Maltese Cross at Epsom, where nearly all the others sank without trace in the gruelling conditions, and ran just as well when he was again ridden prominently to finish second in the Irish Derby at the Curragh (1m4f, good; unraced on firmer) three weeks later, a neck in front of Pierre Bonnard; both of those rivals reoppose and he's now 5lb worse off with Pierre Bonnard, but won't go down without a fight.
runners.comment: Derby win from Maltese Cross and neck ahead of Pierre Bonnard in Irish Derby; 5lb penalty

runners.name: Pierre Bonnard
runners.spotlight: Looked every inch a serious Derby prospect last term, which he failed to confirm behind two of these in the mud at Epsom this June but the Irish Derby at the Curragh (1m4f, good) three weeks later addressed the doubts when he rallied well to finish just a neck behind runner-up Christmas Day; as he receives 5lb today from that rival and from Maltese Cross, that career-best performance puts him clear top on form.
runners.comment: Rallied well in Irish Derby to be a neck behind Christmas Day, from whom he now gets 5lb

runners.name: Galiyan
runners.spotlight: Steady improver in four-race career and he keeps on well for pressure, but this summer's 3l sixth of 11 at Royal Ascot (1m6f Group 2) and half-length second of five at Newmarket (1m5f Group 3, again good to firm) do not suggest he's a match for today's principals at 1m4f.
runners.comment: Steady improver but he is seemingly not a match for today's principals at 1m4f

runners.name: Superior Choice
runners.spotlight: 1,100,000gns yearling; won over 1m2f in a maiden at Leicester and novice at Newmarket, making all in the latter; passed a much tougher test with flying colours when 11-10 favourite for Listed race at Hamilton (1m3f, good to firm) in July, coming from fifth of six to assert gradually in the final 2f; keeps looking capable of better but today's company demands great deal more again.
runners.comment: 3-3 this season, latterly in a 1m3f Listed race at Hamilton; needs much better still

runners.name: Antigua
runners.spotlight: Twice made the running, including for 1m2f maiden win at Fairyhouse in June; disappointing on handicap debut next time and, as an inferior stablemate to two of the star acts in this field, probably set for front-running duties.
runners.comment: Inferior stablemate to two of the star acts, so probably set for front-running duties

races.race_name: Juddmonte International Stakes (Group 1)

runners.name: Ombudsman
runners.spotlight: Impressive in this race last year (good to firm) and took Group 1 tally to four with 4l win in the Prince of Wales's Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) in June last time; star 3yo Constitution River is a new rival but this fellow will be very tough to beat if producing his brilliant best.
runners.comment: Impressive in this last year and at Royal Ascot in June; could be very tough to beat

runners.name: Constitution River
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut last July and 5-5 since, posting Group 1 wins on his last two starts in the Prix du Jockey Club at Chantilly (10.5f, good) and the Eclipse at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm); he's never faced a rival as good as Ombudsman but was impressive when winning the Eclipse by 3l and has the potential to give the Godolphin horse a serious challenge.
runners.comment: Won the Eclipse by 3l; now tackles Ombudsman but could give him a serious challenge
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Item
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-3 when winning the Group 2 Dante over C&D (good) in May on reappearance and bounced back from soft-ground Derby flop to win the Group 2 York Stakes over C&D last month (good to firm; Pride Of Arras second); Ombudsman and fellow 3yo Constitution River have achieved more but his two course wins have come with something in hand and it's hard to identify where the ceiling of his ability lies, especially at York; entitled to respect.
runners.comment: Two impressive C&D Group 2 wins this year; hotter task today but entitled to respect

runners.name: Zaydann
runners.spotlight: From the family of Arc winner Zarkava and this lightly raced 4yo made it five wins in a row with Group 3 success at Vichy (1m2f, soft) four weeks ago; has also won on good ground; this race is considerably hotter and others have a lot more substance to their form but he did it cosily last time and could still have lots more to offer for top French trainer who saddled Calandagan to finish second in this race in 2024 with the same silks; each-way possibilities.
runners.comment: Others have more substance to their form but he's won his last 5; each-way possibilities
runners.owner: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C

runners.name: Hawk Mountain
runners.spotlight: Won the Group 1 Futurity at Doncaster (1m, heavy) last October and reappeared with Group 3 win at Chantilly (1m1f, good to soft) in May; close second to Constitution River in the Group 1 Prix du Jockey Club at Chantilly (10.5f, good) next time, then beaten just over 3l by the same stablemate when third in the Eclipse at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm); has work to do but he could show improvement if settling better than on his last two starts.
runners.comment: Placed behind Constitution River on last two starts, most recently third in the Eclipse
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Almaqam
runners.spotlight: 5yo who showed career-best form to win the Group 1 Tattersalls Gold Cup at the Curragh (10.5f, good) in May on his reappearance; beaten just over 7l by Ombudsman when fourth in the Prince of Wales's Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m2f) where the fast ground may not have been ideal; today's surface is unlikely to be so quick and he's not ruled out each-way.
runners.comment: 4th to Ombudsman at Royal Ascot; less quick ground today can help; not ruled out each-way

runners.name: Devil's Advocate
runners.spotlight: Listed runner-up at Kempton in April but he was a pacemaker for stablemate Ombudsman in the Prince of Wales's Stakes at Royal Ascot last time, when well beaten at 66-1, and that's set to be his role again.
runners.comment: Pacemaker for stablemate Ombudsman when well beaten at 66-1 at Royal Ascot last time

runners.name: Pride Of Arras
runners.spotlight: York has brought out the best in him, as evidenced by last season's Group 2 wins in the Dante (C&D, good to firm) and Great Voltigeur (1m4f, good to firm) and last month's second behind Item in the Group 2 York Stakes over C&D (good to firm); he may have been inconvenienced by making the running last time but has something to find back in a Group 1.
runners.comment: York has brought out the best in him but he has something to find back in a Group 1

runners.name: Action
runners.spotlight: Runner-up to Item in the Dante over C&D (good) in May but well beaten in Group 1s on his next three starts, having made the running each time; looks set for pacemaking duties once more; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Runner-up in the Dante here in May but well beaten in Group 1s since; likely pacemaker
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

races.race_name: Sky Bet Stayers Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Shrimp Shady
runners.spotlight: Won the 17-runner Chester Plate (2m2f, good) in May and beat Team Player by a nose to score at Newbury in July; another step forward when second in Shergar Cup race at Ascot (again 2m on good to firm) 11 days ago and a 1lb rise surely won't prevent another bold show.
runners.comment: Three wins this year and another step forward when second in 2m Shergar Cup race at Ascot

runners.name: Valedictory
runners.spotlight: Stepping up to 1m6f with cheekpieces enlisted resulted in wins at Goodwood (good) and Newmarket (good to firm); that's not ironed out all the kinks, though, as he looked hard work at Glorious Goodwood 18 days ago on his way to a fair fifth of 13, with Small Fry in second; probably needs to resume improvement on this first go at 2m but he's one to be reckoned with if first-time blinkers receive the same response that first-time cheekpieces did.
runners.comment: Fair fifth at Goodwood (1m6f); chance if first-time blinkers work like first cheekpieces

runners.name: Team Player
runners.spotlight: Comes from off the pace; progressed very well initially this season; then wore cheekpieces on last two starts, never getting seriously involved as second favourite in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle but beaten a nose by Shrimp Shady at Newbury (2m, good to firm); in the mix up 2lb.
runners.comment: Resumed his good efforts when beaten a nose by Shrimp Shady at Newbury (2m, good to firm)

runners.name: Ride The Thunder
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner who was on the premises in all six handicaps, albeit managing only sixth of 20 when favourite for Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (upped to 2m) penultimate start on AW debut; on the heels of Shrimp Shady at Newbury latest; pretty reliable but needs to find extra for the win.
runners.comment: Pretty reliable but needs to find extra if he's to win a first handicap at seventh attempt

runners.name: Manxman
runners.spotlight: Progressive in 2023, 2024 and 2025; that included getting pipped in the 2024 Cesarewitch (2m2f, soft) and two big runs last year at Goodwood; runner-up in his 2024 and 2025 reappearances, though not in such good races as this one; would have a lot more to prove on good to firm ground than good or softer, but this 2026 return is off a competitive mark.
runners.comment: Runner-up in his 2024 and 2025 reappearances; this 2026 return is off a competitive mark
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Prydwen
runners.spotlight: 8yo whose 11th success came over 1m4f in April; also effective at 2m this term but edged back up the weights and looks vulnerable for win purposes.
runners.comment: Admirable 8yo but back up the weights and looks vulnerable for win purposes

runners.name: Kirchner
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who was upped to 2m on his third start for this yard when second of 20 in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (AW); smoothly went one better at Ascot (2m, good to firm) four weeks later, admittedly in just a four-runner race (from Ghaiyya and Fireblade) and that has earned him a 6lb rise, but he's relatively unexposed and heading the right way.
runners.comment: Smooth Ascot win (2m; four ran) earned him a 6lb rise but he's relatively unexposed

runners.name: Boatswain
runners.spotlight: 0-8 on turf; that's despite some good form last year but his best two runs this season were on AW, latterly when winning at Southwell early last month on his step up to 2m; that came by 13l in a five-runner race; has a 6lb higher mark in this very different contest but he's unexposed at the trip.
runners.comment: Up to 2m at Southwell (AW; 5 ran) for a 13l win; 6lb higher in this very different contest
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Kilmeaden
runners.spotlight: 1m4f Flat winner at last year's Galway festival and took a maiden hurdle this January; that's from 14 races for Donnacha O'Brien, for whom he was a promising third of 24 to Westminster Moon (1m6f, good) in May and a fair fifth over 2m in June; not beaten far when ninth in 2m Shergar Cup race at Ascot but that shows he needs marked improvement in today's first-time visor (1-8 in cheekpieces), replacing a tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish; today is second run for yard and he needs marked improvement in first-time visor

runners.name: Fireblade
runners.spotlight: Disappointed in this race last year and the form of his close third over C&D that September has not been matched; second of six at Ascot on penultimate start was his best show this term but he needs better than that.
runners.comment: Ascot 2nd on penultimate start was his best show this term but he needs better than that
runners.owner: Elb Bloodstock Ltd And R L Banks

runners.name: Mountain Road
runners.spotlight: Missed 2025; has mostly been coming from well off the pace this term and that yielded a win at Thirsk (2m, good) in May and he ended up on the heels of the leaders in a Shergar Cup race at Ascot (2m, good to firm) when next seen 11 days ago; 5lb claimer takes over in what looks a tougher race.
runners.comment: Won penultimate start, close up latest; 5lb claimer takes over in race which looks tougher

runners.name: Mordor
runners.spotlight: Thorough Flat stayer who reappeared this spring with a career best on Flat to win at Navan (1m6f, heavy) and a creditable third in 3m hurdle race; good ground looked okay for him last season but a muted display at Royal Ascot nine weeks ago perhaps confirmed that anything firmer is not ideal; either way, another career best is needed today.
runners.comment: Muted display at Royal Ascot on good to firm last time; a career best is needed today

runners.name: Small Fry
runners.spotlight: Returned to Flat with an eye-catching effort at Royal Ascot (2m4f); going back down to 1m6f didn't look a problem at Glorious Goodwood (again good to firm) 18 days ago but he suffered a nightmare passage before running on into second of 13 (Valedictory fifth); a 4lb rise adds salt to the wounds but he could still have a big chance.
runners.comment: 4lb rise adds salt to wounds after Goodwood hard luck; could still have a big chance

runners.name: Westminster Moon
runners.spotlight: Ex-Polish and German, placed in 1m2f Group races in 2024; took a while to find his level in Irish handicaps but decisively landed a gamble in a 24-runner race at the Curragh (1m6f, good) in May; should stay this far but never threatened at Royal Ascot (2m4f, sole start on officially good to firm) next time and weakened right out of it at Galway (2m1f) on latest, which leaves him with something to prove again.
runners.comment: Decisively landed a gamble in 24-runner Curragh race (1m6f, good) in May; well held since

runners.name: Duke Of Oxford
runners.spotlight: Eight AW wins, two last winter in 2m handicaps; however, he has tons to prove on turf record (0-7) and even best AW form does not look good enough; reportedly lame after losing right-hind shoe when tailed off 19 days ago.
runners.comment: Has tons to prove on turf record (0-7) and even best AW form does not look good enough
runners.owner: A Cope, B Roberts And J Biggane

runners.name: In The Breeze
runners.spotlight: Only his second attempt over this far in a 31-race career came at Goodwood (soft) ten weeks ago when he came from the rear in a six-runner race to win by 5l; 6lb higher today (with more to prove if the ground is firmer than good) but new horizons as a stayer have been opened up.
runners.comment: Only second attempt over this far saw a 5l win at Goodwood (soft) ten weeks ago; up 6lb

races.race_name: Irish Thoroughbred Marketing Handicap (Heritage Handicap)

runners.name: Shes Got A Brother
runners.spotlight: Won in April on first two starts, then made the frame in two competitive handicaps (5f, good; including here) before creditable Listed fifth at Ayr (5f, soft); she's better than she showed at Goodwood three weeks ago, when minus the hood and failing to settle, but the hood is again left off.
runners.comment: Promising start to career but backward step at Goodwood minus the hood; no headgear today

runners.name: Dolos Dream
runners.spotlight: Made all on handicap debut at Pontefract (5f, good) in June and bounced back from lesser run on soft going at Chester when going very close here (5.4f, good to firm) last time; up in grade today but she came well clear with the winner last time and return to a bare 5f could suit this speedy filly.
runners.comment: Clear of the third when going very close here last time; speedy sort; could make bold bid

runners.name: Naana's Shadow
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who won competitive 5f races at Epsom, York and Glorious Goodwood on her last three handicap starts (good/good to firm); she's 8lb higher than last time but did it in convincing fashion; strong claims.
runners.comment: She's won her last three handicap starts (including here) and holds strong claims

runners.name: Tricky Tel
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row at Hamilton (6f, good to firm) and Chester (5f, good to soft) before midfield finish at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) and runner-up to an odds-on winner at Chester (6f, good) last time; he's particularly effective at Chester but is not ruled out each-way on his first run here.
runners.comment: Runner-up to odds-on winner at Chester last time and not ruled out each-way

runners.name: Call Margot
runners.spotlight: Highly capable on her day, as when going close in the 3yo Dash at Epsom (5f, good) in June; a case can be made on that form but this headstrong filly has been well beaten on both starts since and has something to prove.
runners.comment: Runner-up in the 3yo Dash at Epsom in June but well beaten on both starts since

runners.name: Old Is Gold
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and unplaced on his two outings this season; however, he was strong in the betting for both and it's possible he'll be sharper today in the first-time visor; interesting to see if his backers return.
runners.comment: Slowly away on both outings this season; might be sharper today in the first-time visor

runners.name: Miss Yechance
runners.spotlight: Respectable seventh on stable debut in the 5f 3yo handicap at Royal Ascot (good to firm) and good third of 18 to Naana's Shadow at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; today's track should be a good fit for this front-runner and she could make a bold bid.
runners.comment: Has run well on both starts for yard and York should be a good fit for this front-runner

runners.name: Mighty Magnus
runners.spotlight: Won at Musselburgh (5f, good) in June and did well to finish third at Newmarket (5f, good to firm) last month having been hampered early; however, he was only fifth of 13 over this C&D in between those runs and was disappointing at Musselburgh on latest outing; others are more compelling.
runners.comment: Flashes of promise this term but not at Musselburgh last time; others are more compelling

runners.name: Manatee Mehmas
runners.spotlight: Made debut in April and has run really well behind Naana's Shadow in his two handicaps, finishing third of 13 over C&D (good) then fourth of 18 at Goodwood (5f, good to firm); there's every chance that he will be in the mix in a first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: He's run well to make the frame in his first two handicaps, including C&D; in the mix

runners.name: Zain Primus
runners.spotlight: Third on debut at Newcastle (7f, AW) in February and he won AW novice races at Kempton (6f) and Newcastle (5f) on his next two starts; makes handicap debut in a hot contest after three months off but his stable is in fine form and he certainly brings potential; one to consider.
runners.comment: Two AW novice wins in the spring; makes handicap debut after break with yard in fine form

runners.name: Schrodinger's Cat
runners.spotlight: Won at Redcar (5f, good) in June and short-headed by Naana's Shadow over this C&D (good) seven days later; not beaten far when sixth then fifth in big fields at Ascot (5f, good to firm) and Goodwood (5f, good to firm) on his last two starts; in with an each-way shout.
runners.comment: Short-headed over C&D in June and has continued to run well; in with an each-way shout

runners.name: Black Star Boy
runners.spotlight: Won on reappearance at Sandown (5f, good) in April and denied a clear run when Listed sixth over this C&D (good) next time; soundly beaten in Royal Ascot handicap latest but, with the Sandown form having been strongly franked by the placed horses, he's not written off; a tongue-tie goes on.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten at Royal Ascot but his winning form at Sandown in April reads well

runners.name: Stargazed
runners.spotlight: Second of 17 off this mark on reappearance over C&D (good) in May; however, she hasn't threatened since and, while there have been possible excuses, she now needs to turn things around in a first-time visor.
runners.comment: Second of 17 off this mark over C&D in May but she hasn't threatened since

runners.name: Underwriter
runners.spotlight: He had started to become disappointing but returned to form with a close fourth at 100-1 at Ascot (5f, good to firm) last month on his second stable start; he'd have been closer with a clear run and could be in the shake-up if he gets the breaks.
runners.comment: Returned to form with fourth at Ascot and he'd have been closer with a clear run

runners.name: One And Gone
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who won two in a row in the first half of summer (5f, good) but he finished down the field at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good to firm) and it was the same story at Pontefract (5f, good to firm) on Sunday.
runners.comment: Won two in a row in first half of summer but down the field on his last two starts

runners.name: Revival Power
runners.spotlight: C&D Listed winner (good to firm) at this meeting last August and she followed up in the Group 2 Flying Childers at Doncaster (5f, good); on a handy mark on that form but she's been a long way below that level this year.
runners.comment: 2yo Listed (C&D) and Group 2 winner but a long way below that level this year

runners.name: Baker Blue
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who was sixth of 18 to Naana's Shadow at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good to firm) and has been placed at Pontefract either side of that (5f, good to firm; most recently on Sunday); back into a more competitive race today but this track should suit his style and he has an each-way chance.
runners.comment: Front-runner who has been running well in defeat and this track should suit his style

runners.name: Boston Dan
runners.spotlight: Listed runner-up here last October and he's well treated on that form but he's been a long way below that level on his six outings this season (three of them here); a major turnaround is necessary.
runners.comment: Listed runner-up here last October but long way below that level on his six runs this term

runners.name: Poatan
runners.spotlight: 2yo campaign concluded with good third in Doncaster sales race (6.5f, good to soft); just one start this year, when keeping on strongly for close Listed third at Sandown (5f, good) in June; this sharp 5f may not play to his strengths but he has a Group 1 entry and is one to be interested in.
runners.comment: Close Listed 3rd on sole run this year; may want stiffer test but one to be interested in

races.race_name: Sky Bet Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Henley On Thames
runners.spotlight: He had gone fairly close in two maidens before coming good when upped in trip and making all at Hamilton (6f, good) 18 days ago; this opening mark looks quite tempting based on that and he commands attention.
runners.comment: Came good up in trip when making all (6f, good) 18 days ago; opening mark looks tempting

runners.name: God Given Talent
runners.spotlight: Created a good impression when winning on his debut at Newbury (6f, good) in May; well beaten in the Coventry at Royal Ascot next time but didn't run badly in a Listed event back at Newbury last month; has since left James Ferguson and is tongue tied for this stable/nursery debut.
runners.comment: Didn't run badly in Listed event last month; tongue tied for this stable/nursery debut

runners.name: The Dancing Pirate
runners.spotlight: Showed a good level in his qualifying runs but was only seventh of 18 when favourite for Goodwood nursery (6f, good to firm; Dubai Champion, Sovereign Glory and Super Tuscan ahead) last time; reportedly hung that day, so maybe today's cheekpieces will keep his mind on the job; Oisin Murphy retains the ride.
runners.comment: 7th when favourite for Goodwood nursery latest; cheekpieces on and Murphy retains the ride

runners.name: Bear Lee
runners.spotlight: She took a big step forward from her introduction when comfortably winning a six-runner Musselburgh maiden (5f, good) in June; similar form when fourth of six in C&D novice (good to firm) last month and she's not readily dismissed on this first go in a handicap.
runners.comment: Big step up with 5f maiden win in June; similar form over C&D latest; not dismissed
runners.owner: N Bradley Racing 29, D Scott & P Spencer

runners.name: Brandenburg
runners.spotlight: He was beaten 18l on his debut in March's Brocklesby but showed dramatic improvement to bag Beverley maiden (5f, good to soft) at 25-1 for Stephen Hanlon in May; proved that was no fluke when a big-priced second on nursery debut over C&D for Noel Wilson last month and won at Hamilton (6f, good to firm) just six days later; up 5lb in a much tougher race but he's worth a look; stable debut.
runners.comment: Won for two different trainers, including at Hamilton latest; worth a look on stable debut

runners.name: Dubai Champion
runners.spotlight: Comfortably off the mark at Hamilton (5f, good to soft) in June and he may have been unfortunate (drifted right) when nailed close home on his nursery debut at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good to firm) 19 days ago; up 4lb but Ryan Moore retains the ride and the partnership should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Nailed close home on nursery debut at Goodwood (6f, good to firm) 19 days ago; considered
runners.owner: Future Champions Racing Syn & Mps Racing

runners.name: Super Tuscan
runners.spotlight: He scored on his third start when taking Chepstow novice in June and it was a creditable sixth of 18 in Goodwood nursery (also 6f, good to firm; Dubai Champion and Sovereign Glory ahead) last time; will need to better that, though.
runners.comment: Creditable sixth of 18 in Goodwood nursery last time; will need to better that, though

runners.name: Jumeirah Storm
runners.spotlight: 6f Doncaster novice winner last month who made a solid handicap debut when second of five there (6.5f, again good to firm) three weeks later; this is much more competitive, however, and he's up 3lb; cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Solid h'cap debut when second (6.5f, good to firm) latest; this is tougher; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Fantasy Force
runners.spotlight: His third of six here (5f, good) was a fairly encouraging debut effort but it's been downhill since, including when last of 14 over this trip on AW last time; new cheekpieces will need to help him tap back into that initial promise.
runners.comment: Downhill since debut; new cheekpieces need to help him tap back into that initial promise

runners.name: Havana Sprite
runners.spotlight: Green on debut but hasn't looked back since and, having forced a dead-heat in 6f Newmarket Listed race, she completed a hat-trick on her handicap debut over that C&D (also good to firm) 18 days ago; she was being considered for tomorrow's Group 2 Lowther and warrants close inspection.
runners.comment: Forced dead-heat in 6f Listed race; hat-trick up on handicap debut last time; good chance

runners.name: Peaceful Warrior
runners.spotlight: Made most when taking a Yarmouth novice (6f, good) on his debut in May but came up short in a useful Ascot event last month; has been gelded and he's the least exposed of these; handicap debut.
runners.comment: Came up short in useful Ascot event last month; gelded and the least exposed of these

runners.name: Rlasthope
runners.spotlight: Brocklesby fifth who has shown improved and consistent form in four subsequent outings, including when off the mark in Southwell novice (6f, AW) four weeks ago; probably needs more on this nursery debut but that's not inconceivable.
runners.comment: Off the mark (6f, AW) four weeks ago; probably needs more on this nursery debut

runners.name: Ruler's Pride
runners.spotlight: 550,000gns breeze-up buy who comfortably beat Crystal Queen and one other to win at Ayr (5f, good to firm) on his debut in May; just 13-2 and 15-2 when held in two subsequent Group-race assignments and he still carries plenty of potential into this first taste of handicaps.
runners.comment: Only 13-2 and 15-2 for two Group-race assignments; carries potential into this nursery

runners.name: Towelontheterrace
runners.spotlight: Good-ground Chester novice winner but he was only fourth of seven under a penalty at Ripon (also 6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; opening mark looks punchy on that evidence but it's still early days.
runners.comment: Opening mark looks punchy on latest evidence but it's still early days

runners.name: Savage Mariner
runners.spotlight: A really encouraging debut under Colin Keane at Leicester (6f, good to firm) in May when chasing home the subsequent Albany winner but hasn't come close to matching that form in two subsequent outings, latterly when beaten a long way in Goodwood maiden three weeks ago; hopes pinned on fresh blinkers, a gelding operation and the returning Keane on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in Goodwood maiden three weeks ago; first-time blinkers on h'cap debut

runners.name: Underdog
runners.spotlight: Looked good when taking a Sandown novice (5f, good) in June but safely held in better events subsequently, a 6f Listed event last time; handicap debut.
runners.comment: Looked good in Sandown novice (5f, good) but safely held in better events subsequently

runners.name: Note To Self
runners.spotlight: He was just pegged back in Windsor novice (6f) last month and beaten only a length at Yarmouth (7f, again good to firm) three weeks ago; the drop back to 6f should suit but his opening mark demands a bigger effort.
runners.comment: Just pegged back in novice (6f) last month; beaten 1l over 7f latest; bigger run required

runners.name: Sue's Last Chance
runners.spotlight: All three of his starts have been on good ground over C&D; promising sixth behind Persian Spring on  debut in May was built on when beaten less than 3l in a maiden one month later; didn't match that when down the field a fortnight on, however, and was subsequently gelded; handicap debut.
runners.comment: Built on debut when beaten less than 3l in C&D maiden; down the field latest; gelded

runners.name: Sovereign Glory
runners.spotlight: Bath novice winner (5f, firm) who handled the step up to 6f well when fourth of 18 in Goodwood nursery (good to firm; Dubai Champion second) 19 days ago; considered.
runners.comment: Fourth of 18 in Goodwood nursery (Dubai Champion second) 19 days ago; respected

runners.name: Crystal Queen
runners.spotlight: All three runs at 5f on good to firm; second to Ruler's Pride on debut at Ayr in May and showed the benefit of that experience when nicely on top in Beverley's Hilary Needler just ten days later; far from disgraced when beaten 6l (fifth in group) in good renewal of the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot the following month; off since but she shaped last time as if she's worth a go at 6f and she is one to consider on her nursery debut.
runners.comment: Far from disgraced in good renewal of Queen Mary latest; one to consider on nursery debut

races.race_name: NXT Big Thing Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Guadalevin
runners.spotlight: Has a Group 1 Cheveley Park entry, which looks a long way removed from the form of her four 7f races; however, latest start was her best form (sixth of eight in a Listed race) and it gave plenty of hope, despite pedigree, that 6f will suit her better; should be a big player at this level.
runners.comment: Group 1 Cheveley Park entry; sixth of eight in 7f Listed race latest; should be big player

runners.name: Sayidah Bahra
runners.spotlight: By Naval Crown; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Laraaib (1m4f Group 3) and Arwaah (useful 1m2f) out of 1m 2yo/1m4f Listed winner; while the dam's side suggests longer trips, this newcomer needs a close look.
runners.comment: While the dam's side suggests longer trips, this newcomer needs a close look

runners.name: Angelic Melody
runners.spotlight: 17,000gns yearling; sixth foal; Harry Angel half-sister to French 6.5f-1m2f winner El Torero; dam once-raced half-sister to winners Talbeyah (useful 8.5f-1m2f) and Sarrocchi (1m Listed), out of French 1m Listed winner; yard 0-5 with 2yos this season.
runners.comment: 17,000gns yearling; Harry Angel half-sister to a French winner; yard 0-5 with 2yos in 2026
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd & Julie Camacho

runners.name: Ma Blushin Rosie
runners.spotlight: 17,000gns yearling by Ardad; sixth foal; half-sister to French 6.5f-1m2f winner El Torero; dam once-raced half-sister to winners Talbeyah (useful 8.5f-1m2f) and Sarrocchi (1m Listed), out of French 1m Listed winner; trainer's 2yos have made their mark this season, so she needs a market check.
runners.comment: 17,000gns yearling by Ardad; trainer's 2yos have made their mark this season

runners.name: Sara's Silver Girl
runners.spotlight: Debut form at Ayr (7f, good; 40-1) seems better than her fourth of ten at Catterick (7f, good to firm; 8-1) 16 days later, but she does possess some ability.
runners.comment: Debut form seems better than her second start but she does possess some ability

runners.name: Diamond New Bay
runners.spotlight: Fading into fourth of six in a novice at Thirsk (7f, good to firm) last month was disappointing considering she was sent off at 8-13 for that debut, but she tried to match the well-bred winner 2f out; well-bred filly who can't be dismissed yet.
runners.comment: Not dismissed despite the fourth of six at Thirsk (7f, good to firm) when 8-13

runners.name: Oh So Slow Sloth
runners.spotlight: 4l fifth of eight at 100-1 in a maiden at Ayr (6f, good to soft) nine days ago was a lot better than her debut and the hood used that day is retained; this race should also demand better.
runners.comment: Ayr fifth at 100-1 (6f, good to soft) nine days ago was a lot better than debut

races.race_name: Kingmoor Park Properties Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Peace Belle
runners.spotlight: Won one of three bumpers; fourth this summer in her two races under Flat rules but there the similarity between them ends, as the first race was a AW maiden (9.4f) and the second a six-runner Group 3 at York (1m6f; 125-1); the latter was a slowly run affair but she came from last and was one of the fastest finishers, so a high rating should not be laughed out of court.
runners.comment: York Gr 3 (4th of 6) was slowly run but a high rating should not be laughed out of court

runners.name: Green Area
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to several winners, including two high-class ones, for her stable; third in small-field maidens at Lingfield (1m2f, good) and Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) so she has ability, but Peace Belle has shown significantly more.
runners.comment: She has ability but Peace Belle has shown significantly more

runners.name: Lazy In Red
runners.spotlight: 4,000gns yearling; tenth foal; Advertise close relation to 5f 2yo/6f AW winner Red Showgirl (RPR 81), half-sister to four winners including Fantail (6f/1m, including 2yo; 88) and Fabulous Red (7f 2yo; 83); dam Listed-placed 9.7f winner (100); probably up against it on debut.
runners.comment: 4,000gns yearling; tenth foal and three of the dam's five winners have been fairly useful

races.race_name: North Lakes Energy - Harry Doyle Memorial Maiden Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Long Shot
runners.spotlight: 0-12 but he's reached the frame in five of his last six starts including when fourth of 13 in a classified event at Newcastle (6f, AW) last month; this return to 7f is no problem and he's a key player back in a handicap.
runners.comment: 0-12 but he's generally reliable and is respected back in a 7f handicap

runners.name: April Diamond
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who has been well held in her last two starts but her standout effort was a strong-finishing second in a handicap here (6f, good) in June; has claims if she can recapture that form and this is only her second attempt at this trip.
runners.comment: 0-6 but her standout effort was in a 6f handicap here in June; possibilities

runners.name: Fate's Gambit
runners.spotlight: Close second on debut at Dundalk (7f, AW) in January but he's been beaten 6l or more in all seven subsequent runs; left Robson De Aguiar for £5,500 last month; this is only his third handicap but he needs a transformation for new yard.
runners.comment: Went close on Dundalk debut in January but well held in seven runs since; stable debut

runners.name: Runninman
runners.spotlight: No wins in 12 starts and he returned after a break with a laboured effort on his stable debut at Newcastle (6f, AW) last month; was a long way behind Long Shot in that race and he needs to bounce back near his best; cheekpieces reapplied.
runners.comment: No wins in 12 runs and he was laboured on stable debut at Newcastle last month; opposable

runners.name: Renewable Dream
runners.spotlight: Well treated on his best form for Seb Spencer but he's been out of sorts in his last four runs including when last of eight on stable debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month; overall record is now 0-10 and he needs a major revival.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on his best form but he's now 0-10 and needs a major revival

runners.name: Why Because
runners.spotlight: Out of an Italian Oaks winner but she's yet to be placed and has been well held in four runs for new yard this season; continues to drop down the weights but she was never involved after a slow start at Newcastle last time and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Yet to be placed after eight starts and has been well held in four runs for current yard

runners.name: Blairtum Night
runners.spotlight: Big prices and he's struggled in three novice events including in two turf runs (1m, good to firm) this summer; still early days but he needs improvement back in trip on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo but he needs improvement back in trip on handicap debut

runners.name: Rajawail
runners.spotlight: 28-race maiden who has been tailed off in her last three starts and the latest was at this track (1m, good) last week; can only be watched.
runners.comment: 28-race maiden who has been tailed off in her last three starts; can only be watched

runners.name: Zous Juice
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo but he's not finished closer than 6l to a winner including in five handicaps; mark continues to fall but he has plenty to prove back in trip.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 5yo but he's not finished closer than 6l to a winner; down the list

runners.name: Reenie's Dream
runners.spotlight: Quirky maiden who virtually refused to race at Newcastle in February, but she ran well at Southwell on her penultimate run, and her best effort last season was a close call over C&D; returns after wind surgery and she's not ruled out back at this track.
runners.comment: Quirky maiden but she has form over C&D and is not ruled out on her return from wind op

races.race_name: North Lakes Energy - Harry Doyle Memorial Maiden Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Hey Havana
runners.spotlight: 0-10 but he has finished second in three of his five runs this summer, the latest at Ripon (1m, good) 16 days ago; visor tried today (second in cheekpieces in June when headgear was tried once before); should be involved.
runners.comment: Ten-race maiden but has finished second three times this year; new headgear tried today

runners.name: Big Apple Jack
runners.spotlight: 0-15 but he has shown winning potential, including when keeping on for fourth at Southwell on Sunday having been short of room over 1f out; has to prove his stamina for a stiff 7f though.
runners.comment: 0-15 but has shown winning potential; met trouble at Southwell on Sunday; stiff 7f a query

runners.name: Agric Ranger
runners.spotlight: Not shown a great deal in six runs in sprint events, the latest 12 days ago; new trip/headgear not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Modest form in six runs in sprint races; new trip/headgear not enough to tempt

runners.name: Supreme Dancer
runners.spotlight: Exposed maiden; runner-up in both 7f runs this year, the latest at Ayr last month; should give his running but may have to make do with more minor money.
runners.comment: Exposed maiden; runner-up in two of his three runs this year; each-way shout

runners.name: Tago Mago
runners.spotlight: Promising third in one run for Jamie Osborne as a 2yo (7f, AW); well beaten in three runs for Sam England, including when 50-1 for her handicap debut at Ripon 16 days ago; not easily recommended.
runners.comment: Struggled in three runs for current yard, including handicap debut latest; plenty to prove

runners.name: Danrana
runners.spotlight: Unexposed filly who wasn't beaten far when fifth of 11 on her handicap debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) 18 days ago; this stiffer track can help and she is open to improvement.
runners.comment: Not beaten far on handicap debut 18 days ago; stiffer track should suit; not discounted

runners.name: Uniter
runners.spotlight: Didn't progress for Andrew Balding and he hasn't offered a great deal in three runs for his new stable either; would have finished closer at Wolverhampton 19 days ago had he enjoyed a clear run but still looks vulnerable; drop in class a plus at least.
runners.comment: Not progressing and too risky despite his reduced mark

runners.name: Our Nicola
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden who wasn't at her best on AW over the winter; back from a break with cheekpieces left off.
runners.comment: Modest maiden who was below par on AW when last seen in January

runners.name: Stoneywell
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden; not made a huge impact in handicaps this year, the latest off this mark at Ayr last week; others look stronger.
runners.comment: Not progressing in handicaps and well beaten off this mark at Ayr last week

races.race_name: David Allen IT Solutions Handicap

runners.name: Golden Strike
runners.spotlight: Dual winner since a visor was added in February and he ran another good race when a close fifth of 18 at York (7f, good to firm) last month; 1lb lower here and he should be in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Two wins in a visor since February and he was close up in a big field at York last time

runners.name: Lord Capulet
runners.spotlight: Five wins this year, with first four on AW and latest on turf at Redcar (7f, good) in May; placed twice since that last success but he didn't shine at Doncaster last time and he looks weighted near best off this mark.
runners.comment: Five wins this year but he's climbed up the weights and was well held last time

runners.name: Native Instinct
runners.spotlight: Added to his 2yo novice win when making all to justify support at Musselburgh (7f, good) in June; this is a deeper race but a 3lb rise looks fair and he's well drawn to attack; respected.
runners.comment: Made all to justify support at Musselburgh in June and he's respected off 3lb higher

runners.name: Count Palatine
runners.spotlight: Versatile ground-wise and all four wins have been at 7f on turf; his mixed record this season but he wasn't beaten far at Ayr (1m) last time and is now only 1lb higher than for his last success; not ruled out back in trip.
runners.comment: 7f specialist who is versatile ground-wise and has possibilities back in trip

runners.name: Son
runners.spotlight: 0-22 since his Newbury maiden win in 2023 but he's on a reduced mark and ran well when sixth of 15 at York (1m, good to firm) last time; should get a good pace back in trip and has each-way claims if he gets the breaks.
runners.comment: On reduced mark and he ran well when sixth of 15 at York last time; now drops back in trip

runners.name: Misunderstood
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner in France as a 2yo but he's 0-13 since; yet to be placed in six runs for his current yard but he's on a reduced mark and made some eye-catching late headway at Musselburgh (7f, good) last time; should get a good tow into this race and he could be dangerous.
runners.comment: On reduced mark and was an eye-catching fourth at Musselburgh last time; in the mix

runners.name: Hunky Dory
runners.spotlight: Dual Tapeta winner who won at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) for Jack Morland in April and was a close third there last month; now returns to turf for new yard but he ran some good races last summer including a close second at Doncaster (7f, good to soft); respected back in this sphere.
runners.comment: Close third at Wolverhampton last month and he's respected on his stable debut

runners.name: Vince Lombardi
runners.spotlight: First three wins were on turf but last three have come on Tapeta; only 1lb higher than for his Wolverhampton win in January but that was a Class 5 and he finished out the back in his final run during the winter; now goes back up in grade and he has work to do after 189 days off.
runners.comment: His last three wins have been in lower grades on AW; has work to do on return

runners.name: Havana Prince
runners.spotlight: Got back on the scoresheet with a 20-1 win at Newcastle (7f, AW) in March; didn't get any luck at York next time but he was well held on his return visit at the end of May; has bit to prove again after a break but he's only 1lb higher than for his last win.
runners.comment: Won on AW in March but he's hard to predict and comes with risks attached after a break

runners.name: King Of Fury
runners.spotlight: Five-time AW winner who completed a double when battling well at Southwell (7f) last month; record of 0-14 on turf but he has plenty of placed form in this sphere and is only 2lb higher than last time; could be a big factor again and any rain would be a bonus.
runners.comment: Completed a double off 2lb lower at Southwell last time and he's respected back on turf
runners.owner: Mrs K S Pratt & M Dods

races.race_name: Armstrong Watson Handicap

runners.name: Dream Forever
runners.spotlight: Started this year with a second at Newcastle (6f, AW) in February but he's lost his way in last three starts including a heavy defeat here (7f, good) in May; resumes off a reduced mark but he needs a big turnaround with blinkers added.
runners.comment: Lost his way in the spring and he needs a big turnaround after 90 days off; blinkers added

runners.name: Maximum Velocity
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough when making all in a Redcar handicap (7f, good) in May; mixed form in four subsequent runs, but he went close at Leicester (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces added) last month and had an excuse at Thirsk (stumbled at the start) last time; still unexposed at this trip and he's a big player if he can recapture his penultimate form.
runners.comment: Redcar winner who went close at Leicester last month and had an excuse latest; in the mix
runners.owner: In For A Penny Partnership & Partner

runners.name: Hares Bredth
runners.spotlight: Made the most of a favourable draw, running down the pacesetter at Redcar (6f, good) in June; down the field in both subsequent runs, but he looked stretched over 7f at Doncaster last time and is now only 3lb higher than for his win; could be dangerous back in trip.
runners.comment: Won at Redcar in June and he had excuse when upped to 7f last time; could be dangerous

runners.name: Northern Tempest
runners.spotlight: Raced prominently when a creditable third in a Ripon handicap (6f, good) in May but he's been well held in three runs since; record is now 0-9 and he needs to get back on track after wind surgery.
runners.comment: Nine-race maiden and he needs to revive after wind surgery
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And M Dods

runners.name: Heathers Feather
runners.spotlight: Struggled in his three qualifying runs and same story when eighth of ten on handicap debut at Newcastle (7f, AW) last month; still early days but he needs a transformation on this switch to sprinting.
runners.comment: Unexposed gelding but he needs a transformation on this switch to sprinting

runners.name: Oasis Cover
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Edward Bethell with a good second at Redcar (6f, good) in June but she's not come close to that form in three runs for her current yard; on same mark as for her fifth here (7f, good) last week and she has plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Nine-race maiden who has been well held in three runs for her current yard; opposable

runners.name: Yellow Diamonds
runners.spotlight: Sole win was in a small-field novice at Musselburgh (5f, soft) last autumn but she's on a reduced mark and was an eye-catching second at Thirsk (6f, good) 12 days ago; should go well again and it would be a positive if rain arrives.
runners.comment: Good second at Thirsk last time and it would be a positive if rain arrives; key player

runners.name: Kilmac Air
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in four runs for Donnacha O'Brien this season including when fourth of 15 in a Cork maiden (6f, soft) in May; never dangerous in a Curragh handicap in June but it's still early days and she needs watching in market on stable debut (changed hands for 14,000gns).
runners.comment: Ex-Donnacha O'Brien; still unexposed and she needs watching in market on stable debut

races.race_name: Knights Handicap

runners.name: Hostility
runners.spotlight: Took a while to put his head in front but he is thriving now, winning a C&D handicap in June and adding an apprentice handicap over C&D (for Conor Whiteley) last week; unpenalised today and has plenty in his favour.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins this summer, the latest off this mark last week; plenty in his favour

runners.name: Ephron
runners.spotlight: 2-5 in handicaps this season, coming from off the pace to win at Redcar (1m, good to firm) in April and adding an 8.3f success at Hamilton 18 days ago; 3lb higher today and doesn't have the benefit of Conor Whiteley's claim but he is still low mileage and could progress further.
runners.comment: Two handicap wins at around this trip this year; still has time to do better; contender
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Lxvi And P Demilow

runners.name: Blufferonthebus
runners.spotlight: Chased home Ravishing Beauty here (soft) in June; 1lb lower today but that run has been followed by two disappointing efforts; the more rain to fall the better.
runners.comment: Conditions no problem and on a good mark; below par last twice; rain would aid her cause

runners.name: Beckon
runners.spotlight: 1m AW winner for Harry Charlton in December; sold for 22,000gns in April; low-key stable debut last week and hard to recommend on the back of that.
runners.comment: 1m AW win for H Charlton; low-key stable debut last week; not easily recommended

runners.name: Avatar Jet
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; made all at Southwell (1m) in April; some fair runs in defeat since but he could face competition for the lead and others are more appealing for win purposes.
runners.comment: 1m AW win in April; fair form since but could face competition for the lead here

runners.name: Ravishing Beauty
runners.spotlight: C&D win (soft) in June off a 2lb lower mark; solid efforts in defeat since and the forecast rain won't be a problem; still needs the new headgear to squeeze out a bit more.
runners.comment: C&D win on soft in June; solid form since; change of headgear needs to give her a lift

runners.name: Keep An Eye On It
runners.spotlight: Placed in his first two handicaps and he made no mistake back from a break at Ayr (1m, good to soft) nine days ago; the forecast rain won't hurt his chance and he still has time on his side; one to be interested in under a penalty.
runners.comment: Off mark at Ayr (1m, good to soft) last week; still low mileage; contender under penalty

runners.name: Between Me And U
runners.spotlight: Won on turf (1m, good to soft) three years ago but his three wins since have come on AW; up 7lb for his easy front-running success at Wolverhampton (8.6f) three weeks ago; thriving and commands respect.
runners.comment: Chasing hat-trick after two AW wins last month; the more rain the better now back on turf

runners.name: Barley
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; on a losing run but he has run several good races in defeat this year, including here; more minor money on the cards.
runners.comment: C&D winner but on a losing run; more minor money would seem fairly likely

races.race_name: Sligo Plumb Centre Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Belladaball
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt in bumpers in Fairyhouse Listed in April; hurdles debut run at Kilbeggan last month was okay, early this month still in contention when faller three out in 2m1f Cork mares' maiden; remains capable of better, providing she avoids serious error.
runners.comment: Cork faller; remains capable of better, providing she avoids serious error

runners.name: Carleys Lilly
runners.spotlight: Solid fourth in 2m Clonmel maiden on debut in May but didn't appear to stay 2m4f at Limerick; switched to bumpers both starts at this venue, placed on first occasion; good bit more needed back in a maiden, eligible for a mark after this.
runners.comment: Placed in bumper here; good bit more needed back hurdling, eligible for a mark after this

runners.name: Searcog
runners.spotlight: Modest Flat winner is 0-6 hurdling although improvement of late, finishing a decent fourth of 20 in 2m1f Galway handicap and chased home a ready winner in 7-runner 2m2f Downpatrick mares' maiden, both on good ground; place prospects again.
runners.comment: Steadily improving Downpatrick second; place prospects again

runners.name: Cotswold Blue
runners.spotlight: Has shown a decent level of ability in three bumpers since May (all on good), runner-up at Tramore and Wexford before readily landing 2m1f contest at latter venue last month, sent on some way out and clear in straight for 7l win; half-sister to a couple of hurdles winners and out of a half-sister to Stayers' Hurdle winner Big Bucks, so certainly bred for this; likely the one to beat.
runners.comment: Wexford bumper winner bred for hurdling, likely the one to beat

runners.name: Jolly d'Olivate
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner last November but three hurdling efforts have been modest; easily passed over.
runners.comment: Points' winner but three hurdling efforts have been modest; easily passed over

runners.name: Granny For Sport
runners.spotlight: Poet's Word half-sister to useful 2m5f chase/3m hurdle winner Nelson County; dam well held in 2m2f/2m4f hurdles, closely related to Irish Grand National winner Our Duke; debutante worth a market check although bred to want further.
runners.comment: Debutante worth a market check although bred to want further

runners.name: Tubberfinn Lassie
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in a pair of point-to-points last October and tailed off last of 7 on recent hurdles debut at Downpatrick.
runners.comment: Tailed off last of 7 on recent hurdles debut at Downpatrick

runners.name: Nelliestar
runners.spotlight: Poor sort on the Flat and never sighted on recent hurdles debut in C&D maiden.
runners.comment: Poor sort on the Flat and never sighted on recent hurdles debut in C&D maiden

runners.name: Moonwing
runners.spotlight: Poor efforts in recent maidens at Cork and over C&D.
runners.comment: Poor efforts in recent maidens at Cork and over C&D

races.race_name: Aidan Moffitt Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Tradonthebay
runners.spotlight: Faced a tough task in a maiden at the Galway festival; worth considering on a fair handicap run at Roscommon (beaten around 12l in third), but that was over 3m; hard to be sure if this trip will bring out the best in him; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Faced a tough task in a maiden at Galway, fair 3m handicap run at Roscommon before that

runners.name: Bowgate Street
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent sort; won off 7lb lower here in May; down the field on her next two starts; a clear second, 11l in front of today's rival Granlahan, at Kilbeggan on penultimate start; failed to reproduce that form at the same venue two weeks later.
runners.comment: Inconsistent sort, won off 7lb lower here in May, second at Kilbeggan on penultimate start

runners.name: Granlahan
runners.spotlight: Placed four times over hurdles; third over C&D in June and at Kilbeggan last month, though he was more than 10l behind runner-up Bowgate Street on that occasion; appeared not to stay 2m6f at Ballinrobe; beaten 12l by an unchallenged front-runner when second at Downpatrick; a likely player in a race of modest standard; stable in form.
runners.comment: Beaten 12l when second at Downpatrick last time, third over C&D in June was encouraging

runners.name: Fremantle Doctor
runners.spotlight: Flashes of form over hurdles and fences during a light campaign in 2025; produced a bright display when second to the improving Koeur A Prendre at Ballinrobe last week, on his first outing since March.
runners.comment: Maiden, produced a bright display at Ballinrobe last week on his first outing since March

runners.name: Urban War
runners.spotlight: Won twice in Britain early in his career; was off for a long time; weak Irish form on the Flat and over hurdles since his return; in rear on the Flat at Gowran last week; mid-division at Cork on his most recent hurdles start; new headgear combination
runners.comment: Won twice in Britain early in his career, weak Irish form on the Flat and over hurdles

runners.name: Tasmanian Girl
runners.spotlight: Won 2m Thurles handicap in March 2025 for Aengus King; inconsistent before and after that long-priced success; attracted some support at Wexford last month on her stable debut, faded after stumbling three out; some merit in her run at Cork early in the month.
runners.comment: Poor strike rate is a worry, some merit in her run at Cork on second outing for this yard

runners.name: William F Browne
runners.spotlight: Two Flat wins in 2024; unplaced in three Flat handicaps last month; not disgraced when set a very stiff task in a Galway novice hurdle; down the field in a Flat handicap last week; relatively unexposed over hurdles.
runners.comment: Not disgraced in a novice event at Galway, relatively unexposed over hurdles

runners.name: Tomas O Maille
runners.spotlight: Only one win from 27 starts over hurdles, at Ballinrobe last year off 13lb higher (2m6f, good); badly out of form in four outings this season, three of them at this venue.
runners.comment: Badly out of form in four outings this season, three of them at this venue, no appeal

runners.name: High Honour
runners.spotlight: Gained his sole hurdles success in this event in 2024; unconvincing Flat form this summer makes him hard to fancy; however, he showed fair form over hurdles in the first half of 2025.
runners.comment: Gained his sole hurdles success in this event in 2024, unconvincing Flat form this summer

runners.name: Wings Of Africa
runners.spotlight: Showed next to nothing in maidens; has struggled in three handicaps; 25-1 when pulled up at Wexford 12 days ago; hard to make a case.
runners.comment: Showed next to nothing in maidens, has struggled in three handicaps, hard to make a case

runners.name: Calm Flight Ahead
runners.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; cheekpieces failed to produce any improvement when pulled up at Limerick in May on handicap debut; blinkers tried now.
runners.comment: Pulled up at Limerick in May on handicap debut, blinkers replace cheekpieces now
runners.owner: Miss Phidelma Elvin & Donal P Keane

runners.name: Alentejo
runners.spotlight: One fair run on the Flat in Britain; weak maiden hurdle form; pulled up on handicap debut at Cork; respect for local yard is the only positive.
runners.comment: Weak maiden form, pulled up on handicap debut, respect for local yard is the only positive

runners.name: Invincible Oscar
runners.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; absent since tailed off on handicap debut at Clonmel last December; trainer saddled a winner at this venue early this month.
runners.comment: Weak form in maidens, absent since tailed off on handicap debut at Clonmel last December

races.race_name: Solar Generation Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Kisuton Enki
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to several winners, notably high-class hurdler/chaser up to 3m4f Yala Enki; returned from lengthy absence to finish a clear second in 2m6f Limerick mares' maiden hurdle in April (soft) before contesting bumpers on better ground, chasing home an all-the-way winner in 2m2f Downpatrick mares' contest, not so good over 2m4f at Wexford; this looks a fine opportunity (Jack Kennedy's only ride on the card).
runners.comment: Back from bumpers, the one to beat on her Limerick maiden hurdle second last term

runners.name: Seven Towers
runners.spotlight: Has shown potential in bumpers (including here) and ran a nice race on hurdles debut in 2m Tramore maiden in May (good); after a short break, was well below that form at Wexford last month (2m4f), reportedly blowing hard post-race; remains capable of better, so respected in a weak maiden.
runners.comment: Below best at Wexford; remains capable of better so respected in a weak maiden

runners.name: Mindyourheadmike
runners.spotlight: Much improved in second bumper when allowed to dictate at Clonmel in May, trained then by Terence O'Brien; bought for 42,000GBP a week later and just okay yard debut at Galway early this month, having been made plenty of use of; entitled to come on for that and one to consider now switched to hurdles.
runners.comment: Clonmel bumper winner better for recent yard debut; one to consider on switch to hurdles

runners.name: Hadahi
runners.spotlight: Idaho 4yo cost 4,500euros as a foal and 15,000euros as a 3yo; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Con's Roc (useful 2m6f/3m chase), Lady Kk (2m5f-2m7f hurdle/chase), Rock On Cassie (2m4f hurdle) and Snowrocco (2m7f/3m hurdle); placed on last of four point-to-point runs in the spring for J P Berry; probably best watched on hurdles debut.
runners.comment: Placed once in points' in the spring for J P Berry; probably best watched on hurdles debut

runners.name: Lengaruka
runners.spotlight: Cost 55,000GBP as a 2yo; half-brother to four winners including French hurdle winners Norathir and Louvetot; dam Listed-placed French 1m3f/1m4f winner; Kilbeggan fifth was a step up on his Roscommon debut effort; more needed.
runners.comment: Kilbeggan fifth was a step up on his Roscommon debut effort; more needed

runners.name: Go To The Moon
runners.spotlight: Bought for 40,000GBP after winning a point-to-point last year; however, has struggled badly in a Sligo bumper and 2m5f Roscommon maiden hurdle; questions to answer now.
runners.comment: Points' winner underwhelming so far on the track
runners.owner: A Cahill, M Dowd, P Glancy Partnership

runners.name: Discrete
runners.spotlight: Weak overall form in point-to-points and on bumper debut; never sighted on recent hurdles debut at Ballinrobe; tried in a tongue-tie now.
runners.comment: Not much to recommend so far; tongue-tie now tried

runners.name: Godsend
runners.spotlight: Five Flat wins in Britain, at up to 2m1f, for Sir Mark Prescott and rated 87; bought for 19,000gns last year and 50-1, never sighted on hurdles debut at Galway early this month; may need more time, but this is a much weaker maiden.
runners.comment: Useful on Flat but may need more time to make his mark hurdling

races.race_name: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Love Like This
runners.spotlight: 1-34 over hurdles and 0-12 over fences; hard to be confident with that profile, though she has made the frame in five of her last six outings; career highlight when beating Katie's Kasper over 3m at Kilbeggan in May.
runners.comment: 1-34 over hurdles, hard to be confident with that profile but fair form in recent months

runners.name: Wild Mandate
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in a staying handicap at Galway; her previous course win (over a longer trip than this) was achieved despite an untidy round of jumping; needs to be more fluent.
runners.comment: Pulled up in a staying handicap at Galway, course win was achieved despite an untidy round

runners.name: Mother Ship
runners.spotlight: 18-race maiden over hurdles; C&D third 13 months ago was one of her better efforts but well below that level since returning from a break, including over fences; Darragh O'Keeffe sticks with her despite a moderate Wexford run; first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: 18-race maiden over hurdles, a C&D third 13 months ago was one of her better efforts

runners.name: Gortmore Lady
runners.spotlight: Maiden was placed on a few occasions when trained by Tony Martin; flopped at Downpatrick ten days ago; her previous run at the same venue was respectable, beaten around 10l in third and in front of Sekakarma who improved on that last time.
runners.comment: Flopped at Downpatrick ten days ago, her previous run at the same venue was respectable

runners.name: Hob's Angel
runners.spotlight: Veteran has held her form reasonably well since winning at Clonmel in May; appears held by Sekakarma on running at Wexford 12 days ago; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, veteran has held her form reasonably well since winning at Clonmel in May

runners.name: Firstupbestdressed
runners.spotlight: Modest form including in points; never a threat on stable debut at Downpatrick last month; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, modest form including in points, never a threat on stable debut last month

runners.name: Move It On Over
runners.spotlight: Out of depth in novice events lately and handicap form offers little or no encouragement.
runners.comment: Out of depth in novice events lately, handicap form offers little or no encouragement

runners.name: Georginas Jet
runners.spotlight: Placed in three handicaps last August at up to 2m6f; 10l winner over this trip at Downpatrick in June; held when favourite on next two starts; very closely matched with Phoenix Arizona on running here last time; should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Very closely matched with Phoenix Arizona on running here last time, should be thereabouts

runners.name: Sekakarma
