runners.spotlight: Had a long period on the sidelines; shaped quite well in handicap hurdles at Punchestown and Downpatrick before a career-best when second at Wexford 12 days ago.
runners.comment: Lightly raced for a horse of his age, not a lost cause judged on recent second at Wexford

runners.name: El Arco
runners.spotlight: Cheaply acquired from Britain, very poor form; Gordon Elliott may find the key to him; market may provide a hint as to what is expected.
runners.comment: Cheaply acquired from Britain, very poor form, Gordon Elliott may find the key to him

runners.name: Phoenix Arizona
runners.spotlight: Has shown promise at this venue on his last three starts; fourth in a claimer on final start for previous yard; well backed when third in a higher-grade handicap than this on stable debut, when wrong at the weights; second here 13 days ago; fair chance he can prevail in a rematch with third-placed Georginas Jet.
runners.comment: Has run well on both starts for this stable, can prevail in a rematch with Georginas Jet

runners.name: Ranting And Raven
runners.spotlight: Sixth of 18 at Punchestown in May (2m, good to yielding) represents her best form; in a top stable and still early days; improvement is not out of the question.
runners.comment: Not much so far, in a top stable and still early days, improvement not out of the question

runners.name: Glaoinn An Airgead
runners.spotlight: Maiden pointer; 0-17 over hurdles, yet to display winning potential, three moderate runs this term; towards the rear at Wexford on latest.
runners.comment: 0-17 over hurdles, yet to display winning potential, three moderate runs this term

runners.name: Max Time
runners.spotlight: Poor sequence of chase attempts continued last time, when pulled up at Roscommon; fair hurdles run at Killarney in July; 1-27 hurdles record is a significant negative.
runners.comment: Poor sequence of chase attempts continued last time, fair hurdles run at Killarney in July

runners.name: Laska Du Breuil
runners.spotlight: New headgear combination did the trick when he won a 2m6f handicap at Limerick in May; up 8lb, may be capable of making further progress.
runners.comment: New headgear combination did the trick at Limerick in May, up 8lb, stays further than this

runners.name: Beacon Bypass
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in a point, bumper and three maiden hurdles; tongue-tie and cheekpieces on for handicap debut; up against it.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in three maiden hurdles, tongue-tie and cheekpieces on for handicap debut

races.race_name: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Dream Shaper
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at 28th attempt when landing 2m3f Kilbeggan handicap last month, allowed to slip the field and win unchallenged; no such leeway at Galway since, weakening between final two flights; third over C&D last month, so trip of no concern.
runners.comment: Win when allowed to dominate, may not get that luxury here in a competitive handicap

runners.name: Coolboy Christy
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden but has shaped well on a few occasions, most notably when fourth at Leopardstown (2m2f, soft) in March; not at same level of late, never counting at Galway latest; much more needed.
runners.comment: Generally out of form of late, much more needed

runners.name: Crystabel
runners.spotlight: Up front throughout when winning 2m2f mares' handicap here last month (good); similar tactics employed in 2m2f novices since, third at Ballinrobe and weakened badly when last of 5 here; steps up in trip now.
runners.comment: 2m2f winner off 7lb lower here last month, come up short since in novices; upped in trip
runners.owner: M R D Fleming & G Bruce & J P Ryan & Miss G Ryan

runners.name: Tangara Bay
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced for Henry de Bromhead but she signed off for that yard with a maiden win at Clonmel (2m3f, soft; sold on for £10,000); reluctant to race on yard debut at Galway last month, so caution advised.
runners.comment: Reluctant to race on yard debut at Galway last month so caution advised
runners.owner: Mickey D's Bus Tangara Five Syndicate

runners.name: Midnight Eagle
runners.spotlight: Limerick win last year (for Aengus King) her sole success, but two good runs of late in 2m1f handicaps, clear of remainder when beaten 1l at Killarney and stayed on late into third at Cork; yet to convince over this far.
runners.comment: Good recent form at 2m1f; yet to convince over this far

runners.name: Drombane
runners.spotlight: Took a keen hold in defeat in maiden hurdles at Clonmel and Tramore; settled better but still found one too good on his return to Tramore in May before fading badly on handicap debut at Galway last month (2m); return to longer trip should suit.
runners.comment: Tame Galway effort but return to longer trip could now suit

runners.name: Harpy Eagle
runners.spotlight: Had run well several times in defeat before finally off the mark 11 days ago in 2m4f Wexford handicap, appreciating good ground to win going away in beating a strong favourite (pair clear); 5lb rise looks quite lenient, so major player if ground remains in his favour.
runners.comment: Beat favourite at Wexford, pair clear; 5lb rise looks lenient so big player

runners.name: Bossy Bird
runners.spotlight: Might have won on her handicap debut at Cork but for some interference (2m4f, good); unable to get competitive back to 2m at Galway, so return to longer trip a positive and don't rule out.
runners.comment: Unable to get competitive over 2m at Galway so return to longer trip a positive

runners.name: Ladiam
runners.spotlight: Not the easiest to win with, as her 2-31 record over hurdles illustrates, but both wins have been over this C&D, including off this mark last summer; penultimate Wexford third was a good effort, 3m2f may have been too far last time; place claims back at optimum trip.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner including off this mark; 3m2f too far last time

runners.name: In For The Night
runners.spotlight: Lost form after gaining a first win at Naas last year (2m3f) until much improved on second start for Conor O'Dwyer over same trip at Kilbeggan last month, coming from off the pace for ready 5.5l success (good); strong chance he'll get this longer trip, 9lb rise to contend with.
runners.comment: Ready Kilbeggan success and 9lb rise to overcome; should stay longer trip

runners.name: In The Minus
runners.spotlight: Won Galway 3yo maiden last autumn and back to form in C&D handicap 13 days ago, relishing longer trip to win going away under a patient ride; 8lb rise but can go well.
runners.comment: Up 8lb for recent C&D win but could be up to the task

races.race_name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Mr Dibbs
runners.spotlight: Second on this card last year; poor form in three points last October/November; jumped poorly and pulled up on return to hurdling at Kilbeggan in April; back to form when winning for Sam Curling in first-time blinkers over C&D in May; soft ground may have harmed his cause on stable debut at Roscommon.
runners.comment: C&D winner for Sam Curling in May, soft ground may have harmed his cause on stable debut

runners.name: Strong Contender
runners.spotlight: Now on the upgrade after a low-key start to her career; stepped up on the form of her first two handicap starts when trouncing Tango Theatre (last year's winner of this event) over 3m at Wexford 12 days ago; up 9lb, can remain competitive.
runners.comment: Trounced Tango Theatre over 3m at Wexford 12 days ago, up 9lb, can remain competitive

runners.name: The Little Yank
runners.spotlight: Durable veteran has won twice at this venue; back in form at Kilbeggan recently after a dismal spell that saw him fail to complete in four consecutive races; eight-time winner remains capable when on song.
runners.comment: Has won twice at this venue, back in form at Kilbeggan recently after a dismal spell

runners.name: Sallap
runners.spotlight: Won 2m7f Clonmel handicap last October off a lowly 73; poor on return at Cork but won again back at Clonmel in June, left in the lead by a faller two out; coped admirably with a 7lb rise when scoring at Cork and ran creditably off this mark when fifth in a competitive Galway festival handicap.
runners.comment: Won twice during the summer, ran creditably off this mark in a competitive Galway handicap

runners.name: Ringdufferin
runners.spotlight: Two wins in 2023 for Gordon Elliott on soft and heavy ground; has run four times since joining Arthur Moore; has made the frame in two starts over fences; concerning that his two runs over hurdles have not been of similar standard.
runners.comment: Won twice for Gordon Elliott, fair chase form for this stable, hurdles form not as good

runners.name: Dorans Law
runners.spotlight: Modest 2-29 jumps strike rate (hurdles and fences combined), placed nine times; produced a fair effort over fences at Wexford last month; below that level over hurdles at Ballinrobe last week.
runners.comment: Fair effort over fences at Wexford last month, below that level over hurdles at Ballinrobe

runners.name: Luck Between Us
runners.spotlight: Solid placed maiden form on good ground in the first half of last season; struggled in testing conditions later, including on handicap debut at Cork in December; 33-1 winner at Killarney last month on first run after a break, runner-up Koeur A Prendre has advertised the form; deserves to be a leading fancy.
runners.comment: 33-1 winner at Killarney on first run after a break, runner-up has advertised the form

runners.name: Keep Em Quite
runners.spotlight: Not a bad effort when fifth on handicap debut at Wexford in May, beaten 8l in fifth; made most when second in a 2m6f maiden at Ballinrobe last month; this looks tougher but could feature with a bit of improvement.
runners.comment: Made most when second in a maiden at Ballinrobe last week, fifth on only handicap start

runners.name: Tango Theatre
runners.spotlight: 1-28 over hurdles, that sole win was achieved in this race last year; struggled here last month in a race in which Cornmarket was second; much more like it when chasing home easy winner Strong Contender at Wexford; could go close now
runners.comment: Won this race last year, no match for Strong Contender at Wexford, could go close now

runners.name: Ilbdare
runners.spotlight: A dual C&D winner, his trainer's local track; last year's form also included a second placing behind Cornmarket over C&D; probably needed the run here in May, and was much improved when winning in June; up 5lb for that; deserves respect.
runners.comment: A dual C&D winner at his trainer's local track, up 5lb for win in June, deserves respect

runners.name: Cornmarket
runners.spotlight: All three hurdle wins have come at this venue at 2m4f and 3m2f on decent ground; best run this year when just failing to get up over C&D last month (good); found the competition too hot at Galway; now blinkered for the first time after a tame effort here 13 days ago.
runners.comment: All three wins have come at this track, blinkered after a tame effort last time, respected
runners.owner: John J Cullen & Michael C Barrett

runners.name: Hey Babbs
runners.spotlight: Won a 2m4f Wexford handicap last year; lost form until posting an encouraging third of 15 at Bellewstown in April (3m, yielding); reported in season when missing an engagement in June.
runners.comment: Lost form after a 2m4f win last year, back to near her best at Bellewstown in April

races.race_name: WTW Willis Insurance Brokers Flat Race

runners.name: Dancing Symbol
runners.spotlight: Feel Like Dancing filly; dam point winner, half-sister to bumper/2m hurdle winner On The Wild Side, out of useful 2m hurdler; promising debut second at Wexford 11 days ago (behind a Willie Mullins-trained winner) despite running green; major player.
runners.comment: Promising debut second at Wexford 11 days ago; major player

runners.name: Orderly Conduct
runners.spotlight: Order Of St George gelding; unraced dam is related to several useful bumper and hurdle performers, out of smart bumper/2m-3m hurdle winner Refinement; late headway on last month's Wexford debut suggests there is more to come; could go well.
runners.comment: Late headway on last month's Wexford debut suggests there is more to come; could go well

runners.name: Conor'salwaysright
runners.spotlight: E15,000 3yo; third foal; half-brother by Kew Gardens to 2m7f hurdle winner Embrace The Day; dam won on the Flat at two and was also a hurdle/chase winner; okay debut run at Roscommon early this month without landing a blow; more needed.
runners.comment: Mildly promising Roscommon debut effort; more needed

runners.name: Hetty Parker
runners.spotlight: Harzand half-sister to winners Minx Tiara (useful 2m-2m6f hurdle/chase) and Dolly Watkins (2m5f hurdle); dam 1m4f winner (RPR 73); market best guide on debut.
runners.comment: Harzand half-sister to useful hurdler/chaser Minx Tiara; market best guide on debut

runners.name: Run For Fun
runners.spotlight: Gelding by For Fun cost 25,000euros as a 3yo; half-brother to French 2m1f/2m2f hurdle winner Le Roi Loth; dam French 2m1f hurdle/2m3f chase winner, half-sister to French 2m1f/2m4f hurdle winner Saintrac; top yard had a couple of bumper winners at Tramore last week, obvious player on debut.
runners.comment: Top yard had a couple of bumper winners at Tramore last week, obvious player on debut

runners.name: Bairdin
runners.spotlight: Westerner gelding is second foal of a placed hurdler, a sister to winner Montys Meadow (useful bumper/2m hurdle/2m4f chase), family of Grand National winner Monty's Pass; last of 8 on last month's Killarney debut, having been short of room before home turn; probably best watched for now.
runners.comment: Last of 8 on last month's Killarney debut; probably best watched for now

runners.name: Gruncle
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to winners Blakey Boy (2m4f-3m2f hurdle/chase) and Knocknagoran Lady (2m6f/3m1f hurdle); dam from the family of Grand National winner Rule The World; didn't count on last month's Galway debut when a 100-1 shot; may need more time.
runners.comment: Didn't count on last month's Galway debut when a 100-1 shot; may need more time

runners.name: Kippersandcustard
runners.spotlight: Behind throughout on recent Roscommon debut; blinkers now tried but can only be watched.
runners.comment: Behind throughout on recent Roscommon debut; blinkers now tried but can only be watched

races.race_name: Unibet Interactive Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Withtearsinmyeyes
runners.spotlight: Runner-up to a subsequent Group 2 winner on her debut at Nottingham (8.5f, good) in April and ran to a similar level at Wolverhampton (8.5f) next time; off since a solid third of ten at Windsor (1m, good) in May and now drops to 7f on her return to the AW; contender.
runners.comment: Ran to a similar level on her first two starts; off since a solid third at Windsor in May

runners.name: Merry
runners.spotlight: 0-4 but she was beaten only 3l when third of 11 on her debut over this C&D last December, and posted an improved effort when narrowly denied on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) 19 days ago; returns to a maiden with solid claims.
runners.comment: 0-4 but she posted an improved effort when beaten a neck on her handicap debut last time
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Racing And R Mitchell

runners.name: Spareapenny
runners.spotlight: Showed little when last of five on her debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm; 40-1) last month and a big step forward will be required on her AW debut.
runners.comment: Showed little when last of five on her debut at Yarmouth last month; big step up needed

runners.name: Mile End Road
runners.spotlight: Frankel colt; second foal; dam 6f 2yo winner (including Group 1 Prix Morny; RPR 115), half-sister to Listed-placed 1m4f winner Climate Friendly, out of unraced half-sister to US 1m1f Grade 3 winner Gender Agenda, family of Oaks/St Leger winner User Friendly; has a smart pedigree and he's interesting on his debut.
runners.comment: Frankel colt out of 2018 Prix Morny winner Pretty Pollyanna; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Graniteville
runners.spotlight: Down the field on her debut at Saint-Cloud (6.5f, very soft) last September but she's finished fourth and sixth there in two starts this year (7f/1m), the most recent coming in April; has since left Andre Fabre having been bought for 12,000gns and she's interesting on her stable/AW debut.
runners.comment: Off since finishing sixth over 1m at Saint-Cloud in April; makes his stable/AW debut

runners.name: Palliser
runners.spotlight: 14,000gns 3yo; gelding by Kingman; sixth foal; brother to 7f-1m1f winner Nikovo (including AW; RPR 99), half-brother to winners Dantora (1m2f; 89), Donna Nook (7f AW 2yo/1m turf; 87) and Tremaine (French 1m1f 2yo); dam 7f-1m1f winner (including 2yo/Listed; 102); his stable can ready a newcomer and he's one to keep an eye on in the betting.
runners.comment: 14,000gns 3yo; brother to 7f-1m1f winner Nikovo; one to keep an eye on in the betting

runners.name: Dream Of Albion
runners.spotlight: 45,000gns yearling; gelding by Oasis Dream; half-brother to 6f winner Magical Merlin (including 2yo; RPR 88); dam unplaced 1m 2yo (51), half-sister to Listed winners Choose Me (7.4f; dam of Group 1 winners Persuasive and Creative Force) and Shanghai Glory (6f); watch the betting on debut.
runners.comment: 45,000gns yearling; gelding by Oasis Dream; half-brother to 6f winner Magical Merlin

runners.name: Vincenzo Bellini
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise despite greenness when fifth of eight on his debut at Ffos Las (1m, good) in June but went backwards from that effort over that same C&D two weeks ago; drops to 7f for his AW debut.
runners.comment: Shaped with promise on debut but went backwards from that two weeks ago; AW debut

runners.name: River Nile
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to 6f/7f winner Dubai Treasure (including AW/Listed; RPR 112); sent off 9-2 on her debut at Sandown (7f, soft) last August but she didn't see it out having been caught wide; off since but her half-sister is 2-2 on the AW and the market should be informative on her reappearance.
runners.comment: Sent off 9-2 on her debut last year but didn't see it out on soft ground; absent since

races.race_name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Alpaca's Bullet
runners.spotlight: No better than seventh on her first three starts over 5f and fared no better when eighth of ten on her nursery debut at Leicester (7f, good to firm; beaten 18l) last month; dropped 3lb and now makes her AW debut.
runners.comment: Beaten 18l when eighth of ten on her nursery debut at Leicester last month; AW debut

runners.name: Ten Year Stretch
runners.spotlight: Ran his best race when fifth of seven at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) last month but he was down the field on his nursery debut at Ffos Las (7.5f, good) three weeks ago; now switches to the AW having been dropped 2lb.
runners.comment: Down the field at Ffos Las on his nursery debut three weeks ago; now switches to the AW

runners.name: Dream On Kent
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a seller at Chester (7f, good to soft) and novice at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) in June; however, he's been well held in both starts since, including on his nursery debut at Ffos Las (7.5f, good) three weeks ago; others preferred.
runners.comment: Runner-up twice in June; well held on his last two starts, including on his nursery debut

runners.name: Kochella
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival home on her first two starts for this trainer but she was a solid third of ten here over 6f on her nursery debut two weeks ago; has enough in her pedigree to suggest she'll stay this longer trip and has claims.
runners.comment: Solid third of ten here over 6f on her nursery debut two weeks ago; steps up in trip

runners.name: Beach Ahead
runners.spotlight: Tongue-tied for all three starts, including when sixth of ten in a nursery here over 6f two weeks ago (behind Kochella); left the impression he could be suited by this longer trip on that occasion and makes some appeal despite being drawn widest.
runners.comment: Left the impression this trip could suit when sixth here over 6f but he's drawn widest

runners.name: The Kalonji Man
runners.spotlight: Beaten at least 11l in each of his first three starts and wasn't able to improve on his nursery debut at Chepstow (6f, good to firm; first-time blinkers; gelded) last month; this longer trip needs to bring about some improvement.
runners.comment: Gelded prior to beating only one rival home on his nursery debut at Chepstow last month

runners.name: Aminaty
runners.spotlight: Down the field in each of her three starts (7f; good to firm), most recently when fading into eighth of nine at Epsom 20 days ago; makes her AW and nursery debut with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Down the field in each of her three starts; cheekpieces on for her AW/nursery debut

runners.name: No More Pino
runners.spotlight: Hinted at ability when fifth on his debut at Salisbury (6f, soft) in June; ran below that level on quick ground at Doncaster next time and beat only one home in a conditions event at Ascot (6f, good to firm) last month; has since been gelded and steps up to 7f for his nursery/AW debut (dam won on the AW) with the hood removed.
runners.comment: Hinted at ability on his debut but yet to build on that; gelded; up to 7f; nursery debut

runners.name: Havana Court
runners.spotlight: Best effort from three starts when third of ten in a novice over this C&D in June (beaten around 6l) but he was disappointing at Catterick (7f, good to firm) four weeks ago; switches back to the AW for his nursery debut.
runners.comment: Best effort came when third in a C&D novice in June but disappointed at Catterick latest

runners.name: Chilli
runners.spotlight: Shaped well when fourth of nine on her debut at Chepstow (5f, soft) in June but she hasn't built on that in two starts since (both on good to firm), including in a first-time hood there last month; steps up in trip for her nursery debut with better needed.
runners.comment: Shaped well on her debut (soft) but hasn't built on that since; up to 7f for nursery debut

runners.name: Perfect Hope
runners.spotlight: Hung right when ninth of 13 at Newbury (6f, good to firm) on her second start and she failed to beat a rival home at Ascot (6f, good to firm) last month; steps up in trip for her AW/nursery debut.
runners.comment: Hung right at Newbury and failed to beat a rival at Ascot; up in trip for nursery debut

runners.name: Printing Money
runners.spotlight: Modest form in three starts in maiden/novice company (6f/7f) but he was sent off favourite on his debut at Windsor in May; has been gelded since last seen 49 days ago and switches to the AW with a tongue-tie/blinkers applied; open to progress on his nursery debut.
runners.comment: Modest form in three starts but sent off favourite on his debut; has been gelded
runners.owner: Hold My Beer, N Bradley 6, L Bearman

runners.name: Sakowin
runners.spotlight: Eighth of ten on his debut at Newbury (6f, good) in May and hasn't built on that in two starts since; has been given wind surgery since last seen two months ago and steps back up in trip on his nursery/AW debut; may do better.
runners.comment: Hasn't progress from his debut outing; has had wind surgery; handicap/AW debut

races.race_name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Sonic Angel
runners.spotlight: Group 1 Dewhurst and Group 2 Champagne entry; Dark Angel colt who made a winning debut at Newcastle (6f, AW; 4-5) 19 days ago, pulling around 4l clear with the runner-up; pedigree suggests this extra furlong will be no issue but stall 13 doesn't make life easy under a penalty.
runners.comment: Made a winning debut over 6f at Newcastle 19 days ago; stall 13 doesn't make life easy

runners.name: Hoshi
runners.spotlight: 80,000gns yearling, 100,000gns breeze-up buy; colt by Sea The Stars; sixth foal; brother to 9.4f AW/1m2f turf winner Inquisition (RPR 80); half-brother to 7f-8.5f winner Nuance (including 2yo/Qatar); dam 1m-10.5f winner (including Group 3; 110), half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Veracious; pedigree suggests he may be one for slightly longer trips but he's interesting.
runners.comment: Sea The Stars colt; dam 1m-10.5f winner; may be one for slightly longer trips
runners.owner: Mrs M C Sweeney & Alan King

runners.name: Perfect Heir
runners.spotlight: 32,000gns foal, 50,000gns yearling; gelding by Perfect Power; seventh foal; half-brother to winners Hebridean Nomad (1m 2yo/1m4f AW; RPR 77) and Giava Dream (French 1m3f); dam 1m winner (67), half-sister to Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner Mon Cadeaux and useful 6f/7f winner Indian Creak; his half-brother won here over 1m on his second start.
runners.comment: 32,000gns foal, 50,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners including Hebridean Nomad

runners.name: Stytch
runners.spotlight: 75,000gns yearling, 80,000gns breeze-up buy; colt by Too Darn Hot; third foal; dam 1m AW 2yo winner (RPR 94), half-sister to winners Total Commitment (useful 6f/7f including 2yo) and Crystallium (7f 2yo), is granddaughter of Fillies' Mile winner Crystal Music; stable also runs Hoshi.
runners.comment: 75,000gns yearling, 80,000gns breeze-up buy; dam 1m AW 2yo winner (RPR 94)

runners.name: Lady Nenaz
runners.spotlight: 60,000euros yearling; filly by Hello Youmzain; fourth foal; unraced dam closely related to 1m2f Group 1 winner Lily Of The Valley, half-sister to 5.5f/6f Listed winner Calbuco, out of maiden half-sister to useful/prolific 5f-1m2f winner Hurricane Spirit; look out for market clues on her debut.
runners.comment: 60,000euros yearling; unraced dam closely related to 1m2f G1 winner Lily Of The Valley

runners.name: Algaihabane
runners.spotlight: Dubawi colt; third foal; dam 7f 2yo winner (RPR 94), half-sister to 1m4f Group 2 winner Qilin Queen, out of 1m4f winning half-sister to Irish 1,000 Guineas winner Nightime (dam of multiple Group 1 winner Ghaiyyath); his dam went close here on her debut and she's interesting on her debut for a stable that won this in 2024.
runners.comment: Dubawi colt; dam 7f 2yo winner, half-siter to 1m4f Group 2 winner Qilin Queen; interesting

runners.name: Liberty's Hall
runners.spotlight: Colt by Nathaniel; eighth foal; brother to French 1m1f/1m4f winner Born With Wings (RPR 100), closely related to 7f-1m1f winner Majoris (including GB 2yo/HK; 95), half-brother to winners Dream Of Stars (1m2f/1m4f; 93) and Rasaasy (1m4f AW; 81); dam placed 1m1f (66); one to monitor in the betting.
runners.comment: Colt by Nathaniel; brother to French 1m1f/1m4f winner Born With Wings (RPR 100)

runners.name: Give Hand
runners.spotlight: 70,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Capital Theory (9.4f-1m5f including AW; RPR 96), Senesi (1m; 82), Palifico (5f AW; 79) and Sahana (7f AW/1m turf; 74); dam Group-placed 1m 2yo winner (103), out of half-sister to Arc runner-up White Muzzle; makes appeal on debut.
runners.comment: 70,000euros yearling; dam Group-placed 1m 2yo winner (103); makes appeal on his debut

runners.name: Uncle Zello
runners.spotlight: Colt by Rumble Inthejungle; third foal; dam Listed-placed 5f/6f 2yo winner (RPR 92), half-sister to Graded stakes-placed 5f-7.5f winner Jeanie B, out of Listed-placed 5f/6f winner; has a speedy pedigree.
runners.comment: Colt by Rumble Inthejungle; dam Listed-placed 5f/6f 2yo winner; has a speedy pedigree

runners.name: Shaddock
runners.spotlight: Kingman colt; second foal; dam 7f/8.6f 2yo winner (including AW; RPR 89), half-sister to Group 1 winners Bluestocking (1m2f/1m4f including Arc) and Qirat (1m Sussex Stakes), out of 1m Group 1 winner; makes plenty of appeal on pedigree for a stable that has won this twice in recent years, including with Qirat in 2023.
runners.comment: Out of a winning half-sister to Bluestocking and Qirat; the latter won this race in 2023

runners.name: Time To Climb
runners.spotlight: 22,000euros yearling, 46,000gns breeze-up purchase; colt by Gregorian; second foal; half-brother to Italian 5f/6f 2yo winner Lion In The Jungle; dam 5f 2yo winner (RPR 73), half-sister to winners Rufus King (useful 6f-1m including 2yo) and Papa Power (1m2f), out of Listed-placed 1m winner.
runners.comment: 22,000euros yearling, 46,000gns breeze-up purchase; half-brother to a winner in Italy

runners.name: Carrow Road
runners.spotlight: Beaten 20l when last of six on his debut at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) in May and beat only one rival home at Lingfield (7f, AW) last month; best watched.
runners.comment: Well beaten on his debut at Hamilton (5f) and at Lingfield (7f); best watched

races.race_name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: St Hilda
runners.spotlight: Beaten a neck at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) on her second start and took another step forward when second of eight at Goodwood (1m2f, good to firm) next time; wasn't at that level on her handicap debut at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) last month but has claims returned to a novice if seeing out this longer trip.
runners.comment: Runner-up on her first two starts this year; held on her handicap debut; steps up to 1m4f

runners.name: Liberate
runners.spotlight: Built on his debut effort when third of seven at Ffos Las (1m2f, good) in June and, despite being beaten at odds-on, ran well when runner-up at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) two weeks ago, pulling 11l clear of the rest; stepping up to 1m4f should suit and he's a leading contender on his AW debut.
runners.comment: Turned over when odds-on at Yarmouth latest but should be suited by this step up to 1m4f

runners.name: Bankatary
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner at Huntingdon last October; fair efforts in two starts on the Flat, finishing fourth of 13 at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) and fifth of 14 at Southwell (1m4f, AW); the latter start has been well franked by the winner but this 4yo may be of more interest in handicaps.
runners.comment: Bumper winner at Huntingdon last year; fair efforts on the Flat; may be one for handicaps

runners.name: Feelin' Free
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise when second of eight behind a subsequent winner at Ffos Las (1m2f, soft; 28-1) two months ago and has been off since; she's a half-sister to a 1m4f AW winner and she should be suited by stepping up in trip on her AW debut; contender.
runners.comment: Shaped with promise on her debut at Ffos Las over 1m2f; half-sister to a 1m4f AW winner

runners.name: Lucy The Wire
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner at around 2m and she went close on her Flat debut at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm; 6-5) three weeks ago; the winner has since been beaten in a handicap but this filly is open to progress in this sphere, particularly now stepping up in trip.
runners.comment: Dual hurdle winner who went close on her Flat debut over 1m2f at Windsor three weeks ago

runners.name: Wreck It Ronnie
runners.spotlight: Dam US 1m turf winner; missed the break slightly but made some eyecatching late progress into sixth on his debut over 1m3f here (20-1) two weeks ago; the third has won since and this colt looks a likely improver over this longer trip.
runners.comment: Made some eyecatching late progress into sixth on his debut over 1m3f here two weeks ago

runners.name: Tide Lines
runners.spotlight: Hinted at promise on her debut at Catterick (1m4f, good) in October but she was well beaten here over 1m3f last month; this 4yo now steps back up in trip with better needed.
runners.comment: 5yo; hinted at ability on her debut at Catterick in April but well beaten here since

runners.name: Quiet Summer
runners.spotlight: Dam German 1m4f winner; sent off 22-1 when last of four on his debut at Haydock (1m4f, good to firm; beaten 23l) in April and now switches to the AW on his first start since; a big step forward is needed but the market may be informative.
runners.comment: Off since finishing last of four on his debut at Haydock in April; big step forward needed

runners.name: Gold Hill
runners.spotlight: Brother to 1m7f hurdle winner Yosemite Gold; showed ability when fourth of 11 on his debut at Brighton (1m, good to soft) in October 2024 but absent and gelded since; has left James Tate and steps up in trip with the hood applied for his yard debut; best watched.
runners.comment: Off since his debut in October 2024; gelded since; up in trip with hood on for yard debut

runners.name: Arklan
runners.spotlight: Missed the break and ran green on his debut at Windsor in June, and he was beaten 40l when down the field over 1m3f here two weeks ago (behind Westender); may yet do better but others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Missed the break on his debut at Windsor and beaten 40l here last time; others stronger

runners.name: Westender
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on his debut at Sandown (7f, good) and returned from over a year off (gelded in the interim) with a never-dangerous seventh of 12 over 1m3f here in a race won by an impressive newcomer; handicaps may be more suitable.
runners.comment: Off for over a year and gelded before his latest effort here; looks one for handicaps

runners.name: Eshowe
runners.spotlight: Hooded for both starts; failed to beat a rival on his debut at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) in December and faded into tenth of 14 at Southwell (1m4f) last time on his first start for 231 days; stall 12 isn't ideal and his pedigree suggests shorter trips will suit.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two previous starts (1m/1m4f) and stall 12 isn't ideal; others preferred

races.race_name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)

runners.name: Lake Como
runners.spotlight: Won twice on the AW in December, including in a Southwell handicap off a 6lb lower mark than today's, and posted an improved effort when third of nine in a conditions event over this C&D in March; disappointed on turf at Epsom (1m2f, soft) when last seen 74 days ago but makes appeal back on the AW in first-time cheekpieces having been gelded.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner and third in a C&D conditions event in March; gelded since last seen

runners.name: Lucky Camino
runners.spotlight: Placed in his first three starts (8.5f/1m) and posted an improved effort when winning a five-runner race on his handicap debut at Hamilton (8.5f, good; first start since being gelded) last month; up 4lb but he's related to AW winners and remains open to progress after just four starts.
runners.comment: Posted an improved effort when winning on his handicap debut at Hamilton; now 4lb higher

runners.name: Chapter
runners.spotlight: Caused a 40-1 surprise when winning in first-time blinkers at Sandown (1m2f, good) in June and backed that up when caught on the post at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW); well drawn and there's no obvious reason why he can't go well.
runners.comment: Won in first-time blinkers at Sandown and caught on the post at Wolverhampton last time

runners.name: Victory Ace
runners.spotlight: Doubled his tally when narrowly winning over 1m at Newcastle last month and followed up with another narrow AW success here over 7f in first-time cheekpieces two weeks ago; they are now discarded but he's shortlisted off this 4lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Has won his last two starts over 1m at Newcastle and 7f here; up another 4lb

runners.name: Darn Hot Gallop
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner last November and made a winning handicap debut at Newmarket (1m, good) in April; lost her unbeaten record in the 1,000 Guineas next time and then was well beaten in the Sandringham at Royal Ascot; last of six over 1m2f at Newmarket last month but a case can be made now that she drops back to 1m on her return to the AW.
runners.comment: Won her first three starts (2-2 on the AW); failed to prove her stamina for 1m2f latest

runners.name: Breakdancer
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner but not when he won twice on the AW last August, including here over 7f; 8lb above the most recent success but he gave it a good go from the front when third at Ayr (1m, good) 11 days ago; has to be considered.
runners.comment: Won twice on the AW last August, including here; gave it a good go at Southwell last time

runners.name: Night Wolf
runners.spotlight: Fifth in the Convivial Maiden at York last August when trained by John & Sean Quinn but couldn't build on that on his stable debut at Redcar (7f, good to soft) next time and was tailed off at Pontefract (1m2f, good) in April; has since been gelded and has cheekpieces applied for his AW/handicap debut.
runners.comment: Fifth on debut last year but hasn't matched that in two starts since; handicap debut

runners.name: Lili Marleen
runners.spotlight: 1m AW winner in France last December but she's struggled since; last of ten over this C&D a week ago and has plenty to prove.
runners.comment: 1m AW winner in France last December but she's struggled since; plenty to prove

runners.name: Mr Professor
runners.spotlight: The most recent of his five wins came in the 2024 Lincoln on soft; left the impression his first start for 324 days was needed when sixth of 13 at Thirsk (1m, good) on his stable debut in May but this C&D winner has been off again since.
runners.comment: Without a win since 2024 but may have needed his stable debut in May; off again since

races.race_name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)

runners.name: Fight Your Corner
runners.spotlight: Two wins last winter, including a C&D handicap off 4lb lower; sent off favourite for his return from six months off at Newcastle (1m) last month but shaped as though the run was needed; Billy Loughnane retains the ride and he still has time to do better.
runners.comment: Unexposed 5yo; should be sharper for last month's return to action; remains of interest

runners.name: Exposure
runners.spotlight: Won twice in France; three solid efforts since joining the Gosdens, the latest in a 7f handicap at Newmarket 19 days ago; dam was a C&D winner so there could be more to come on this AW debut.
runners.comment: Three solid efforts for new yard; dam a C&D winner so could take well to AW

runners.name: Starlight Time
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden (7f, good) and a novice (1m, AW) as a 2yo; unplaced in three handicaps this year but slipping down the weights; too soon to write him off.
runners.comment: Two wins as a 2yo but yet to make an impact in handicaps in 2026; bit to prove for now

runners.name: Luzon Heights
runners.spotlight: AW winner (1m) last September; his form dipped at York 40 days ago but he had been in good form earlier in the year; each-way shout.
runners.comment: AW winner; form dipped at York last month but earlier efforts give him an each-way shout

runners.name: Captain Fox
runners.spotlight: Didn't have to improve on his 2yo form to win a novice at Lingfield (1m, AW) in February; beaten in three handicaps since but he is slipping down the weights.
runners.comment: 1m AW novice win in February; three handicap defeats have followed; down in weights

runners.name: Elan d'Or
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a pair of AW wins, the second coming over C&D off 5lb lower; the handicapper has been in command this year but he's not discounted back on AW.
runners.comment: C&D winner in December; handicapper in command so far this year; not ruled out back on AW

runners.name: Racingbreaks Ryder
runners.spotlight: Back to something approaching his best this summer, winning handicaps at Newcastle (1m) and here (7f) on his last two starts; well drawn to attack but a 5lb penalty could scupper his hat-trick bid.
runners.comment: Chasing a hat-trick after summer AW wins; penalty for last week's 7f win could scupper him
runners.owner: Cottier, Racing Breaks & Old Gold Racing

runners.name: Double Eagle
runners.spotlight: Modest form in four runs for George Boughey last year, failing to improve on his handicap debut (1m) last October; sold for 10,000gns later that month and gelded; only of interest if backed on his belated stable debut.
runners.comment: Low-mileage 3yo; absent 314 days and gelded; best watched on stable debut

runners.name: Herculeus
runners.spotlight: Won twice at around 1m on turf last year; ended that campaign with two lesser efforts and he hasn't found his best in three runs this year; opposable despite his slipping mark.
runners.comment: Two turf wins last year but ended 3yo campaign with a whimper and yet to get going in 2026

races.race_name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div III)

runners.name: Talis Evolvere
runners.spotlight: Five of his six wins have come on AW, including C&D; last won at Southwell (1m, Tapeta) in January; not so good on turf of late but he's dangerously handicapped if the switch back to AW prompts a revival.
runners.comment: Last won (1m, Tapeta) in January; not so good on turf of late but dangerously handicapped

runners.name: Rogue Defence
runners.spotlight: 2-2 on AW; won at Lingfield (1m, Polytrack) on his debut in April and scored again over that C&D when taking a novice last month; carries plenty of potential into this handicap debut and Billy Loughnane retains the ride.
runners.comment: 2-2 on AW and he carries plenty of potential into this handicap debut; leading contender

runners.name: Port Road
runners.spotlight: Course regular who won this race last year off 4lb lower; won again over C&D in January and secured a third success when bagging Lingfield handicap (7f, Polytrack) in April; now just 1lb higher after three lesser efforts and he's not readily dismissed.
runners.comment: Won this race last year off 4lb lower; now just 1lb above his last winning mark

runners.name: Cavolo Nero
runners.spotlight: His second of 11 over C&D (wore cheekpieces) on reappearance in March was a new high and he bettered that when landing soft-ground Yarmouth handicap (1m) in first-time blinkers in June; off since and no headgear for this stable debut (same owners) but he still commands respect.
runners.comment: Won 1m turf h'cap in June; off since and blinkers absent; still respected on yard debut

runners.name: Malachy's Wish
runners.spotlight: Defied a penalty to win Tapeta novice (7f) in September and it was a career best when landing Lingfield event (7f, Polytrack) last Tuesday; carries a 6lb penalty but that was just his second handicap and further progress could be on the cards; player.
runners.comment: Won (7f, Polytrack) last Tuesday; 6lb penalty but that was just his second h'cap; player

runners.name: Helm Rock
runners.spotlight: Two wins from ten starts over C&D include a success in April off 3lb lower; didn't look in a great mood at Ascot last time but he still ran well to finish fairly close fourth; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Two wins from ten starts over C&D include a success in April off 3lb lower; not ruled out

runners.name: White Crown Star
runners.spotlight: Could be encouraging that his only win for Andrew Balding came on his sole start here (7f novice) but he left that stable after a poor show at Chester last July and it's been a similar story in two outings for this yard; only of interest if lively in the betting.
runners.comment: Hasn't got going in two outings for this yard; only of interest if lively in the betting

runners.name: Port Erin
runners.spotlight: Two wins over C&D but his mark suffered after a comfortable win at Sandown (1m, good) around a year ago; handicapper's releasing his grip and last time's fifth at Ffos Las was a step in the right direction, however; might go well.
runners.comment: Two wins over C&D; mark edging down and last time was a step in the right direction

races.race_name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap

runners.name: Generous Rascal
runners.spotlight: Placed twice over 6f for new stable (including here) and he kept chipping away when fifth over 7f at Wolverhampton (Tapeta; first-time blinkers) 19 days ago; form figures here read 123 and he's worth considering back at this venue from a tempting mark.
runners.comment: Kept at it over 7f (first-time blinkers) last time; form figures here read 123; contender

runners.name: Piazza
runners.spotlight: Her fifth of 12 over C&D in June was a fair effort and she bettered that when going close at Ffos Las (7.5f, good) a fortnight ago; gets a 2lb nudge for that but she's in the picture.
runners.comment: June C&D fifth was a fair effort; bettered that when going close on turf last time; chance

runners.name: Viviana
runners.spotlight: Went close to winning her first race when coming home well for second at Carlisle (7f, good) last Tuesday; same mark and she's joined by Billy Loughnane for this AW debut; big player, particularly if she can stay in touch, despite the widest stall.
runners.comment: Strong run for second (7f, good) last Tuesday; same mark and gets Loughnane for AW debut

runners.name: Unionville
runners.spotlight: Went close on his handicap/stable debut here in January and he opened his account when sharing a Chelmsford maiden (also 6f, Polytrack) three weeks later; three lesser runs followed but it was a step back in the right direction when upped to this trip and third at Sandown four weeks ago; has become quite nicely treated.
runners.comment: Shared 6f Polytrack maiden in February; step back in the right direction latest

runners.name: Strong Voice
runners.spotlight: Unfortunate not to go closer when second at Ffos Las (7.5f, good) off this mark in June but he hung for pressure when posting a lesser effort at Sandown four weeks ago; tongue-tie and cheekpieces might help and he had 7f AW form in novices; could bounce back.
runners.comment: Second off this mark (turf) in June; not so good latest but tongue-tie/cheekpieces go on

runners.name: Slack Bob
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in Lingfield handicap (7f, Polytrack) in May and it was a similar effort when third on turf at Newbury (1m, good to soft) one month later; couldn't match that over 7f at Ayr last time but he's not ruled out back on AW.
runners.comment: Won (7f, Polytrack) in May; not so good on turf last time but not ruled out back on AW
runners.owner: The Old Etonian Racing Syndicate II

runners.name: Station Bar
runners.spotlight: Not the most consistent and after winning three-runner Bath handicap (1m, firm) in May he beat one rival at Salisbury and Ffos Las; drops back to 7f in added blinkers and he's still 4lb above his winning mark.
runners.comment: Won at Bath but beat one rival at Salisbury and Ffos Las; drops back to 7f in new blinkers

runners.name: Obsidian Verse
runners.spotlight: Couldn't reward market support on his handicap debut at Lingfield (7f) in March but he got the job done dropped to 6f at Southwell (Tapeta) one month later; only midfield at Wolverhampton last month but things didn't go to plan that day and he remains unexposed at this trip.
runners.comment: Won 6f Tapeta handicap in April; excuse last time and he remains unexposed at this trip

runners.name: Eduardo Calderon
runners.spotlight: Yet to score but he went fairly close at Leicester (7f, good to firm) on his handicap debut in April; hasn't repeated that effort in two subsequent runs, including over that C&D last time, but it's still relatively early days and he's back down in grade.
runners.comment: Went close (7f) on handicap debut; hasn't repeated that but he's back down in grade

runners.name: Santiago Boy
runners.spotlight: His form started to wobble in novices but his best run came over C&D in that sphere and the return to this venue and added blinkers steadied the ship when 50-1 second (1m; drawn widest) on his handicap debut last Monday; has had issues at the start but the draw has been kinder this time and he warrants consideration from the same mark.
runners.comment: Return to this venue & blinkers helped when second (1m; drawn widest) last Monday; chance

runners.name: G'Emmethegreenlite
runners.spotlight: Patchy form in three qualifying runs for Adrian Keatley last year and he was beaten a long way when last of 11 on his reappearance and handicap/stable debut at Haydock (6f; hooded) in April; goes up a furlong for his first bash at AW.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way when last of 11 on reappearance and handicap/stable debut in April

races.race_name: CopyBet Bog Now For York Tomorrow Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Yes Day
runners.spotlight: He's on a reduced mark and has been in pretty good heart since these blinkers went on; however, he needs something extra if he's to post a first win since March 2025, and a longer trip is probably preference.
runners.comment: In pretty good heart in these blinkers but needs something extra and may want further

runners.name: Harrys Hope
runners.spotlight: Good second over C&D (good) last September and ran pretty well in fourth over C&D (good) four weeks ago, when she was hampered three out on her second start back from a break; wears first-time cheekpieces and could get closer to the target this afternoon.
runners.comment: Ran pretty well over C&D four weeks ago and could get closer to the target this afternoon

runners.name: Muskerry Rock
runners.spotlight: Point/hunter chase winner who went close over hurdles on first two starts for this yard before handicap chase win at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good to firm) last month; did it nicely last time and a 5lb rise may well not stop him.
runners.comment: Did it nicely at Newton Abbot when back over fences and a 5lb rise may well not stop him

runners.name: Palamon
runners.spotlight: Returned to form in a reapplied tongue-tie (retained since) and justified strong market support at Bangor (2m4f, good) in March; mixed form since, however, and only fifth at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) last month following a break and wind surgery; needs to raise his game and is unproven at the trip.
runners.comment: Well-backed winner at Bangor in March; mixed form since and unproven at the trip

runners.name: Smugglers Haven
runners.spotlight: Made all at Fontwell (2m5f, good) in May when back over hurdles and runner-up at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good) since; she can make mistakes and fell on her last chase start in December, but won over fences at Cheltenham (3m1f, good to soft) previously; respected under regular rider Lily Bradstock.
runners.comment: Won over fences last October and has been in good form over hurdles; respected

runners.name: King Roly
runners.spotlight: Back to form with 9l second to well-handicapped winner at Market Rasen (extended 2m5f, good) in June and it was the competitive Summer Plate there in which he was soundly beaten last time (hampered four out and wasn't disgraced); could be in the mix back down in grade, provided the step back up in trip isn't an issue; wears first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Back to form at Market Rasen two starts ago and was up against it there last time

races.race_name: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Alshadhian
runners.spotlight: Needs to rebound from last month's poor hurdle run but was second in two good-ground C&D chases last summer (including this race) and has slipped to a good mark; will be dangerous if back on song in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Ran poorly over hurdles last time but was second in two C&D chases last summer
runners.owner: G C Myddelton & V E C Taylor

runners.name: Getaway Jewel
runners.spotlight: Four-time chase winner who has made the frame on all four starts since returning from a break in May, most recently when second at Cartmel (2m1f, good) last month; has his limitations and is not getting any younger but ought to give another good account.
runners.comment: Not getting any younger but has been consistent this season; probably won't be far away

runners.name: Definite Dream
runners.spotlight: Went very close off today's mark on chasing debut at Stratford (2m1f, good to firm; form has worked out well) in May, after a layoff; major player if judged on that effort but finished rather weakly on both subsequent outings and is now 0-21 under all codes.
runners.comment: Went close at Stratford in May but finished rather weakly on both subsequent outings

runners.name: Dexter
runners.spotlight: Now 1lb lower than when winning at Cartmel (2m1f, good) last summer but has not been at his best this season, and was behind Getaway Jewel when fourth at Cartmel last month; needs to up his game.
runners.comment: Won off 1lb higher last summer but has not been at his best this season

runners.name: Greer Hill
runners.spotlight: Caused 28-1 surprise over C&D (good) on chase debut in June and bounced back from lesser effort when third over 2m4f here (good) last month; remains lightly raced and this drop back in trip looks the right move; respected.
runners.comment: C&D winner in June; back in trip after running well over 2m4f here last time; respected

runners.name: Turpin Gold
runners.spotlight: Did well for Tom Lacey in early part of last season, winning three times over hurdles, and reappeared with fairly encouraging chase debut in May; failed to build on that when well-held fourth over C&D last month but still enters calculations in this lower grade.
runners.comment: Shade disappointing when well-held fourth here last month but drops in grade today

runners.name: Iolaos Du Mou
runners.spotlight: Free-going front-runner; just 1-14 over hurdles but was seemingly back in good form when placed at Uttoxeter (2m, good) last month; could take some catching if he gets into a good jumping rhythm on chasing debut.
runners.comment: Free-going front-runner; placed over hurdles last month; makes chasing debut today

runners.name: Hiero Sport
runners.spotlight: 2-11 over hurdles, the latter win gained from the front at Fontwell (2m3f, good) in April; not quite in same form when dropped back to 2m1f there in May and makes chase debut after three-month break but could have a say.
runners.comment: Won over hurdles in the spring; makes chase debut after a break but could have a say

runners.name: Mr McWhinny
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 8yo; didn't get home after racing too freely over 3m on stable debut in June but was evidently well suited by drop to about 2m2f (if additional yardage is included) when scoring at Market Rasen (good) last month; could easily have more to offer for new yard; must be considered.
runners.comment: Suited by drop back in trip when winning last month; has more to offer for new stable

runners.name: Keep Me Posted
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in all seven Irish points this year and made low-key return to racing under rules when well beaten here (2m4f, good) on last month's stable debut; drops back in trip with cheekpieces tried today.
runners.comment: Well beaten over 2m4f here on stable debut; drops back in trip with cheekpieces tried

races.race_name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Mares' Maiden Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.name: Elated
runners.spotlight: Left behind by ready winner when second at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good; first-time cheekpieces) last month but has now made the frame on all four hurdling starts; ought to act as a good benchmark here.
runners.comment: Made the frame on all four hurdling starts; ought to act as a good benchmark here

runners.name: Sparkling Water
runners.spotlight: Delivered on promise shown for Ralph Beckett during the winter when winning good-ground Uttoxeter bumper for new stable last month; ought to play another major role on this hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Won Uttoxeter bumper on last month's stable debut; major player on hurdling debut

runners.name: Take The Boat
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat racer at up to 1m6f with 4-22 strike-rate; placed on all three hurdling starts, most recently when third at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good to soft) last month, and has good each-way claims again.
runners.comment: Placed on all three hurdling starts and has good each-way claims again
runners.owner: Posh Pundit Racing Club & G Nicholls

runners.name: Sweet Honey B
runners.spotlight: Won a point bumper in 2023 and came third in two 2m3f hurdle races towards end of that year but returned from long absence with two underwhelming runs last winter and has been off for another seven months since.
runners.comment: Returned from long absence with two underwhelming winter runs; off another 219 days since

runners.name: Nala The Lioness
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in three bumpers in 2024 but her Flat win in June came in a basement-grade classified race and she'll need to take pretty well to hurdling to pose a threat here.
runners.comment: Won basement-grade Flat race in June but will need to take pretty well to hurdling

runners.name: Dreaming Of The Dr
runners.spotlight: Displayed minor promise in all three bumpers, most recently when sixth of 12 (about 12l behind Sparkling Water) at Uttoxeter (good) last month; more will be required on this hurdling debut, though.
runners.comment: Displayed minor promise in all three bumpers but more will be needed on hurdle debut

runners.name: Blue Topaz
runners.spotlight: Point winner who came good under rules at second attempt, with clear success in five-runner Sedgefield bumper (good) in October; had excuse (bled from the nose) when pulled up there on hurdling debut in November but we haven't seen her since.
runners.comment: Sedgefield bumper winner; absent since pulled up (bled) there on hurdle debut in November

runners.name: Datstheholyallofit
runners.spotlight: Displayed improvement in her third bumper, winning by over 6l at Kelso (good) in May; it's tricky to gauge what that form is worth but she should have a future over jumps.
runners.comment: Won Kelso bumper by over 6l in May; should have a future over jumps

runners.name: Do Wah Diddy
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in good-ground Bangor bumper in May, after a long absence, and needs significant improvement on this hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a bumper in May, after a long absence; significant improvement required

runners.name: Evenly
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to useful jumper Bobs Law; beaten about 18l when sixth of 14 in course bumper in June; probably best watched on hurdle debut.
runners.comment: Beaten about 18l when sixth of 14 in course bumper in June; hurdle debut today

runners.name: Adba
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability during five-race Flat career for Ralph Beckett but was in rear throughout (ride attracted stewards' attention) when making hurdling debut against own age-group last month.
runners.comment: Showed some Flat ability but was in rear throughout on recent hurdle debut

runners.name: Matilda Maid
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to stable's Cheltenham Gold Cup winner Coneygree and high-class jumper Carruthers but finished well down the field in a course bumper on debut in June.
runners.comment: Well down the field in course bumper on debut in June

runners.name: Pearl Knot
runners.spotlight: Unseated rider at first flight on hurdle debut in June and did not get seriously competitive in two subsequent Uttoxeter novices (both 2m, good).
runners.comment: Did not get seriously competitive in two Uttoxeter novices last month

runners.name: Lady Bee Great
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in heavy-ground Limerick claiming hurdle on latest rules start in February but won two British points in May and has possibilities here if able to replicate the best of last year's Irish form.
runners.comment: Dual point winner in May; a possible if able to replicate last year's best Irish form

runners.name: Whinny Houston
runners.spotlight: Struggled in two course bumpers when owner-trained in June 2025; makes stable/hurdle debut after 420-day absence.
runners.comment: Struggled in two course bumpers when owner-trained in June 2025

races.race_name: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)

runners.name: Newbrook Diamond
runners.spotlight: Useful 6yo who gained a somewhat overdue hurdling success at Wexford (2m4f, good) last month and also made all at Cartmel (2m6f, good) a fortnight later; ought to give this a good shot under 12lb penalty.
runners.comment: Made all at Wexford (2m4f) and Cartmel (2m6f) last month; ought to give this a good shot

runners.name: Likewhatyousee
runners.spotlight: Ended five-race Irish Flat career with 1m4f maiden win in October and has performed well in three novice/maiden hurdles for new stable this season, most notably when winning by 10l at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good) two runs ago; can be in the shake-up if suited by this new trip.
runners.comment: Won by 10l at Newton Abbot (2m1f) last month; in the shake-up if this new trip suits

runners.name: Road To Wembley
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful Flat stayer who drew clear to score by over 6l at Aintree (2mf, good) in May and is now 2-3 over hurdles; has the big 12lb penalty here and Sean Bowen is replaced by an amateur but could be seen to even better effect over this longer trip; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: 2-3 over hurdles after 2m1f Aintree win in May; could be even better over this longer trip

runners.name: Square d'Alboni
runners.spotlight: Listed Flat winner as a 2yo and showed the benefit of his winter wind op when scoring in good style over hurdles at Stratford (2m2f, good to firm) and here (2m, good) this summer; tries a new trip today; big player.
runners.comment: Tries new trip after winning in good style over 2m2f and 2m this summer; big player

runners.name: Handmedownastar
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner; placed on first two hurdling starts for Seamus Mullins (2m1f/2m2f) and showed improved form when easily making all by 8l at Fontwell (2m3f, good) in May; needs to make further progress for new stable (same owner) but that's possible.
runners.comment: Made all at Fontwell for Seamus Mullins in May; may progress again for new stable

runners.name: Bright Legend
runners.spotlight: 1-19 over hurdles, the win gained from the front at Sedgefield (2m4f, good) in April; below that form when fifth of six in recent 2m Uttoxeter handicap, though, and others in this field have much more potential.
runners.comment: Won Sedgefield maiden in April but is fully exposed after 19 hurdle starts

runners.name: Oneinthewell
runners.spotlight: Just held on to win Market Rasen handicap over nearly 2m6f (if additional yardage is included) last month, opening his hurdling account at the tenth attempt; evidently in good nick, but not favoured by the weights on this return to novice company.
runners.comment: Narrow handicap winner last month; not favoured by weights on return to novice company

runners.name: Cadillac Ranch
runners.spotlight: 0-7 in Irish points; won good-ground Charing maiden on British debut in December but pulled up all three starts since; can only be watched on rules debut.
runners.comment: Pulled up in all three points since Charing maiden win in December; rules debut today

runners.name: Delgany Headline
runners.spotlight: Did not get competitive in first two hurdle races (both 2m); upped in trip today; stable has much more obvious chance with Square d'Alboni.
runners.comment: Did not get competitive in first two hurdle races (both 2m); stable second string

runners.name: Shesonnet
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in good-ground C&D handicaps on last two outings, latterly behind Phantom Gold five weeks ago; 12lb better off with that rival today but has a bit to find with some of the others.
runners.comment: Runner-up in C&D handicaps on last two outings but has a bit to find with some of these

runners.name: Not Now
runners.spotlight: Well-held 66-1 shot when last of three finishers on hurdling debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in June; passed over.
runners.comment: Well-held 66-1 shot when last of three finishers on hurdling debut in June

races.race_name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners.name: Babychino
runners.spotlight: Placed in three of her five handicaps, most recently when clear second of six under Sophie Carter at Stratford (2m6f, good to firm) last month; competes off same mark here; can make her presence felt again.
runners.comment: Clear second at Stratford last time and has now been placed in three of her five handicaps

runners.name: Starshine Legend
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat racer who launched hurdling career with two fairly promising 2m runs this season; took a backward step here last time but moves up in trip for this handicap hurdle debut and could be boosted by the refitted cheekpieces (he had a good record in headgear on the Flat).
runners.comment: Has shown promise in his qualifying runs and might be boosted by the refitted cheekpieces

runners.name: Lucky In Taipan
runners.spotlight: Struggled in four novice/maiden hurdles last year and was beaten nearly 33l when 9-4 second favourite for last month's stable/handicap debut; needs significant improvement over this new trip but it will be interesting to see whether he's strong in the betting again.
runners.comment: Beaten over 33l on stable/handicap debut; tries new trip here; market strength interesting

runners.name: Gone In Sixty
runners.spotlight: Kept on for respectable third over C&D (good) four weeks ago and remains on a workable mark but has 1-40 career strike-rate and others appeal more for win purposes.
runners.comment: Placed over C&D last month but has a 1-40 career strike-rate; others preferred

runners.name: Iamcelestialgift
runners.spotlight: Won over 2m3f on hurdle debut in April 2025 but generally disappointing since; always behind in 2m7f handicap here on latest outing six weeks ago; drops back in trip with blinkers tried today.
runners.comment: Generally disappointing since a winning hurdle debut in spring 2025; blinkers tried today
runners.owner: DL Adams, JA Adams & G McPherson

runners.name: Warner's Cross
runners.spotlight: Quirky customer who returned to form with come-from-behind win on last month's stable debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; first-time hood); remains a tricky horse to predict but this 7lb higher mark ought to be manageable.
runners.comment: Quirky customer who returned to form with a come-from-behind win on stable debut

runners.name: Midnight Jewel
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner last year; signed off with two poor runs in the autumn but was respectable fifth of 13 over C&D (good) off his lower hurdle mark when returning last month; not out of this if that run brought him on.
runners.comment: Fair fifth over C&D last month, after a layoff; not out of this if that run brought him on

runners.name: Dynamite Defense
runners.spotlight: Outran 50-1 odds when third over C&D (good) last month, his third start for Sarah-Jayne Davies, but needs a better performance today and his overall profile remains unconvincing.
runners.comment: Placed at 50-1 odds over C&D last month but overall profile remains unconvincing

runners.name: Mrs Biddle
runners.spotlight: 0-15 over hurdles and inconsistent when trained in Ireland but her second of 11 at Sligo (2m4f, good to yielding) in the autumn was a good effort; makes stable debut after 284-day absence; market may guide.
runners.comment: 0-15 and inconsistent over hurdles in Ireland; market may guide on this stable debut

runners.name: Could Be You
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on stable/handicap debut at Ffos Las (2m4f, good) in April but was given a wind op soon afterwards and remains unexposed; well worth keeping an eye on in the betting.
runners.comment: Well beaten on stable/handicap debut but had wind op soon afterwards; worth market check

races.race_name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div II)

runners.name: Ghost Jury
runners.spotlight: 0-10 over hurdles but won a small-field point in the spring and bettered her low-key rules return when rallying second at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good) last month; no surprise if she features.
runners.comment: Rallied for second at Newton Abbot (2m5f) last month; no surprise if she features

runners.name: Bannister
runners.spotlight: Regressive 9yo who has modest strike-rate in recent years and returned from break with two underwhelming runs in July (2m4f/2m7f); revival needed.
runners.comment: Regressive 9yo who returned from layoff with two underwhelming runs in July

runners.name: Royal Rhythm
runners.spotlight: Arrested decline when third over C&D (good) on last month's hurdle return and has possibilities if in the right mood again but has become far too inconsistent to rely upon.
runners.comment: Third off much-reduced mark here last month but far too inconsistent to rely upon

runners.name: Brooklyn Lullaby
runners.spotlight: Much more competitive since switched to handicaps for last two runs, more recently when second (albeit no match for winner) at Stratford (2m2f, good to firm) in June; upped in trip again here; likely contender.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Stratford in June and remains lightly raced; likely contender

runners.name: Bound For Glory
runners.spotlight: Won fast-ground Stratford bumper by wide margin in May and has made the frame on both hurdling starts since (2m2f/2m); makes handicap debut from what looks a realistic mark and could still have potential.
runners.comment: Bumper winner; made the frame on both hurdling starts; considered on handicap debut

runners.name: Crafty Gael
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 7yo; 0-16 over hurdles but made promising stable debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; first-time tongue-tie) last month, keeping on for third; not yet fully exposed over this sort of trip; shortlisted.
runners.comment: 0-16 over hurdles but made encouraging stable debut last month, keeping on for third

runners.name: Boskill Borden
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on chasing debut in the autumn and also ran poorly when reappearing last month; might be happier now back over hurdles and has slipped to a good mark but others have much less to prove; swaps cheekpieces for refitted visor.
runners.comment: Pulled up over fences here last month; revival needed on return to hurdling

runners.name: Cosmic Spirit
runners.spotlight: A well-beaten 66-1 shot in his first two handicaps (both 2m); needs combination of new trip and tongue-tie to prompt massive improvement.
runners.comment: A well-beaten 66-1 shot in his first two handicaps; up in trip with tongue-tie added

races.race_name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Betty's Tiara
runners.spotlight: Won maiden at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good) last September but has lost her way; tried chasing on last two starts; blinkers replace cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Won maiden at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good) last September but has lost her way; blinkers now

runners.name: Ikigai Star
runners.spotlight: Last won at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) in May 2025; while not so good over the last year, he has gone down the weights and third of six to The Great Escape over C&D (his first run beyond 2m5f) last time gives him a place chance.
runners.comment: 3rd of six to The Great Escape over C&D (first run beyond 2m5f) gives him a place chance

runners.name: Redbridge Rambler
runners.spotlight: Won over fences at Warwick (3m, good; 2lb higher today) in May but backward steps in his two starts since, despite market prominence; now has first hurdle race since November 2024 and cheekpieces return in place of the recent visor.
runners.comment: Backward steps in his last two chases; now has his first hurdle race since November 2024

runners.name: Back In The Bay
runners.spotlight: Can front-run; did well in May-July 2025; although well beaten, latest start (chase debut) was at least a step back in that direction; probably needs overall improvement stepping up from about 2m4f.
runners.comment: Latest start (chase debut) was at least a step back in the right direction; up in trip
runners.owner: Value Racing - Back In The Bay

runners.name: Fiskardo
runners.spotlight: Led on the post in a good-ground Perth bumper in April, after a long layoff; comparable form since in his three starts over hurdles but handicap debut (Uttoxeter extended 2m4f) last time didn't yield improvement, which will be needed here with another major step up in trip.
runners.comment: Handicap debut (Uttoxeter extended 2m4f) last time didn't yield improvement

runners.name: Mancero
runners.spotlight: Won over 2m4f here in May and over C&D four weeks ago, both on good ground and they were the only two races in which he's been ridden by Sean Bowen; raised another 7lb after doing it well last time but this 4yo remains lightly raced over this sort of trip, which seemed to suit him so well that day.
runners.comment: His two wins (here, C&D latest) are the only two races he's been ridden in by Sean Bowen

runners.name: Mistral Blue
runners.spotlight: Worked her way back to peak form and scored by just over 4l at Uttoxeter (near 3m, good) in June; ran poorly over that same C&D last month, however.
runners.comment: Won at Uttoxeter (near 3m, good) in June; ran poorly over that same C&D last month

runners.name: Stiletto
runners.spotlight: 4-10 under Sean Bowen, under whom he was well held four times this year before winning over C&D (good) in July on latest outing; up 7lb and the champion jockey turns elsewhere this time.
runners.comment: C&D win (good) in July on latest outing; up 7lb and the champion jockey turns elsewhere

runners.name: Barry Fife
runners.spotlight: Almost a year off before this March; has not matched earlier promise in this year's five races, switched to handicapping for last three; appeared over C&D last two and made most when connections turned to blinkers last time but his third of ten that day was a well-beaten one; now tries a visor.
runners.comment: Has not matched earlier promise in this year's five races; now tries a visor

runners.name: Atreides
runners.spotlight: Won twice over fences within a week last December; some minor honours since and edging back down the weights for this first hurdle race since February 2025 but trying this longer trip on penultimate start resulted in his worst recent performance; 10lb claimer is recruited.
runners.comment: Edging back down the weights for this first hurdle race since February 2025; stamina doubt

runners.name: Cinnodin
runners.spotlight: Six-time Flat winner; opened account over hurdles at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good; refitted cheekpieces) in May, after a break, and ran at least as well there three weeks later; pulled up at Newton Abbot in June but spreading a plate during the race might excuse that; considered.
runners.comment: Running well before pulled up at Newton Abbot in June when he spread a plate; considered

runners.name: Kenzo Des Bruyeres
runners.spotlight: Dual Irish point winner; launched chasing career with underwhelming runs on last three starts (3m/3m2f) and has managed no better than fourth in his six races under rules; he's now 10lb lower than on handicap debut, though, and a visor replaces the usual cheekpieces.
runners.comment: He's now 10lb lower than on handicap debut and a visor replaces the usual cheekpieces

runners.name: The Great Escape
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on handicap debut here (2m4f, good) in July 2025; struggled in his next five starts but went down the weights and took advantage from the front in a six-runner C&D race (good; by a nose, with Ikigai Star third and Final Entry fourth) five weeks ago; back up 2lb but a player if he can back up that effort.
runners.comment: Up 2lb now but a player if he can back up latest start when back to some form for C&D win

runners.name: Sims' Law
runners.spotlight: Has struggled badly on all four starts; moves up from 2m4f; 10lb wrong at the weights in this second handicap.
runners.comment: Has struggled badly on all four starts; moves up from 2m4f; 10lb out of the handicap

runners.name: Farhh Echo
runners.spotlight: Fourth in maiden here (2m, good) last July but safely held in handicaps on all five starts since, including once at 2m6f; wore cheekpieces four starts back and again today, plus new tongue-tie; needs to turn a big corner.
runners.comment: Equipment changes but he needs to turn a big corner

races.race_name: Prix Occitanie (Listed Race) (Fillies) (Turf)
